notes.title: Season 4 Domination Out Now!
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=VOU2e8LzwAw;full][/previewyoutube]

Greetings Officer!
Season 4 introduces 2 new Divisions featuring new Units, Upgrades, Commander Abilities, Cosmetic Packs and new playstyles. We're also introducing 'Commander License', a way to help new players to ease into the Eximius RTS experience better. Other addition includes a new Impossible difficulty, updated lighting in all levels, an all-new AXR soundtrack and some updates to Homeland Security. 

Full patch notes below!

[GAMEPLAY]
[list]
[*] Added GSF Commando Division
[*] Added AXR Pioneer Division
[*] In-game chat will now only display player’s Callsign instead of player’s account name
[*] Commanders now automatically enters RTS view at the start of every match
[*] Added East Asia Servers
[/list]

[COMMANDER LICENSE]
[list]
[*] Commander License is a requirement for new players to play as Commanders (RTS) in Online play
[*] Commander License can be earned by reaching Rank 10
[*] Returning players with Medals from Season 1 ~ 3 will automatically be granted the Commander License
[*] AI Commander will take over Commander role in games if there are players with no Commander License
[/list]

[IMPOSSIBLE DIFFICULTY]
[list]
[*] Added new Impossible Difficulty for Team Skirmish and Offline Play
[*] AI will control all resource and victory points and have all research and tech unlocked at the start of the game
[/list]

[LIGHTING]
[list]
[*] Updated Morning, Noon, Clear, Twilight and Cloudy lighting
[*] Improved visibility on all lighting and reduced shadow intensity to prevent players and units from hiding in darker areas
[*] Updated textures for some darker mesh to respond better to the new lighting
[/list]

[CO-OP MISSIONS]
[b]Homeland Security[/b]
[list]
[*] Increased Brutal Difficulty and introduced new enemy type and waves (Good Luck)
[*] Slightly expanded the play area around the North SAM site
[/list]

[b]Urban Hustle[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed player being able to get permanently stuck inside a dumpster
[/list]

[COSMETIC PACK]
[list]
[*] Added a total of 10 new Cosmetic Pack for AXR and GSF
[*] Players can now preview skins on other Units and Battlesuits in the Store
[*] Replaced Eden Core currency icon
[/list]

[SOUNDTRACK]
[list]
[*] Added AXR Soundtrack. AXR Soundtrack will only play when playing as AXR
[/list]

[LOCALISATION]
[list]
[*] Added Japanese Localisation
[*] Updated Chinese, German & Russian text
[/list]

[MISC]
[list]
[*] Changed Anti-Aliasing quality setting to Anti-Aliasing method instead
[*] Replaced ‘Hunker Down’ Squad Command to ‘Hold Position’
[*] Updated Intel page to reflect latest changes on all units, structures and vehicles
[*] Removed Retreat Buff Icon on Support Crawler when Shield is deployed
[*] Added new overencumbered buff icon for Aegis when Shield ability is used
[*] Weapon Crew members will now stand behind the machine gun or mortar when deployed
[*] Fixed Scout upgraded icon not displaying for players who joined a game later
[*] Fixed AI Infantry units not reloading when their gun magazines are empty
[*] Fixed M34 Flamethrower flames not following the correct direction
[*] Fixed laser pointers on Gauntlet CPC and G12 not being centered when switching from RTS view to FPS view
[*] Fixed Elite Marine prioritising using hand grenades after receiving Equipment Upgrade
[*] Fixed Covert Vanguard ‘Execute’ ability not killing the target
[*] Improved vehicle stability while reversing
[*] Fixed Armory Turret continuing to fire at a dead or destroyed target
[*] Fixed AXR Structures being able to un-deploy when affected by EMP
[*] Fixed Main Menu buttons being partially cropped at resolution above 1920x1080
[/list]

[KNOWN ISSUE]
[list]
[*] In Quick Play, East Asia Servers are labeled incorrectly as Auto
[/list]

notes.title: Eximius 1.1.9 Hotfix - 5th January 2023
notes.notes:
Greetings officers,

Our first hotfix of the year of 2023. A quick patch to address some of the recent issues in season 3.

Few main highlights include fixing the payment methods on Epic Games Store, making the DLC now purchase-able. The server browser filters has also been added.

[h1]New Feature[/h1]
[h3]Added Filters for Game Session / Lobby ID, Settings and Sorts in Server Browser[/h3]
[list]
[*] Pre-Game Lobby now shows the Lobby ID after the Lobby Name
[*] In-game Menu now shows the Lobby ID / Session ID, player can share this to their friends to allow them to search
[*] Remove limits for searching lobbies (previously was 50)
[*] Show some additional settings in the server browser, such as Victory Points, Annihilation and Death Match
[*] Added unequip skin button to customization skin menu to reset skins to default.
[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/43108ca88bb68e921906fd92544d649e39ae847d.png[/img]

[h1]Improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*] Capped main menu frame rate to 60fps. Previously may cause frames overdrive, causing GPU to overwork.
[*] Changed the default crouch key to Ctrl (instead of C)
[/list]

[h1]Balance Change[/h1]
[list]
[*] Support crawler's spawning of Ironguard changed slightly. They will now start spawning only when deployed for the first time. When Service Ironguard is killed, they will start a spawn countdown to spawn the next one, but only when the Crawler is deployed. This will prevent the service ironguard to spawn while the crawler is on the move. 
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed Issue with Eden core unable to be purchased in the store.
[*] Fixed graphical glitch on Covert Vanguard's stealth wall in Twilight lighting.
[*] Fixed graphical glitch when deploying scanner-type abilities by Commander. It used to make things hard to see while scanner is active.
[*] Fixed issue with Bio-Injector texture showing as grid.
[*] Fixed scope sights glitch which causes sights to be blurry
[*] Fixed issue with bus disappearing in Town Square map
[*] Fixed a glitch that causes the APC to not play it's deploy animation. 
[*] Fixed issue with Power plant that reduces energy gained when building a new power plant
[*] Fixed issue with Resource tooltip not showing correct number
[*] Fixed issue with Search Bar text can be overflowed and extended indefinitely
[*] Fixed issue with Epic Games Store DLC entitlements
[*] Fixed issue with ATR Firespear where it no longer spawns lingering fire on the ground
[*] Fixed issue with Specialist Strike Squad where they can't be control-group selected
[*] Fixed issue with AI Commander spamming weapon crew senselessly.
[*] Fixed issue with Skirmish AI will no longer deploys mortar on location that has sky occluded.
[*] Fixed issue with Viper's claw when hooks an officer will permanently get stunned if Viper moves behind a wall
[/list]

notes.title: Season 3 Breakthrough Out Now!
notes.notes:
Greetings Fellow Officers,

A new season has begun and with that new additions, improvements and tons of changes that is sure to change up your play style. We are also Introducing a new Premium store with brand new Premium cosmetics so do check them out as well.

[h2][b]Enjoy the update and welcome to Eximius Season 3 Breakthrough![/b][/h2]
Refer below for the full patch notes.

[h1]Eximius is now running on Unreal Engine 5![/h1]
With this bring the new Lumen lighting and Vehicle Physics Improvements! Here are some Screenshot preview with the new Lighting. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/ef63e5f9a793c58b27f9567f26664410c623b0cc.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/c531779de59383af5c41ddcbc9559a5b73ceded2.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/57830cf678c230c0cfa0ae3331a1862d25f609a2.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/896c41387711a7bf0d3cc563720071273975122f.png[/img]

[h1]New Features[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]RTS Key override Settings[/b]
Players are now able to change their key input for all units and all commands based on their own preference 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/e4365f994c12fc99d5de679fa676f548fcc6e764.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/cc262f8c81ddcd465b07c61b576aa2c79a7b3adb.png[/img]

[*] [b]Pop-Up Turret function for Locked down armory and mules[/b]
When a resource point has been secured by an armory or Mule players are able to mount a pop up turret on it.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/2d9b8e07c6af12ef76be8aeee4a40ef9c6ff565a.png[/img]

GSF Pop-Up Turret 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/72ddb74ffa96b5024f3337355b1a4273d70d2a70.png[/img]

AXR Pop-up Turret
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/1188e16ffc05846d96ce6995bd807cad084e950f.png[/img]

[*] [b]Added 7 new Season 3 challenges medals[/b]
[/list]

[h1]Support Crawler Revamp[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]AXR Robotics Division has now gained a new Support Crawler NV unit[/b]
Support Crawler NV is able to spawn service Ironguard but with a max limit of 2. If one is destroyed another will spawn in after a short delay and if the crawler is destroyed all Service Ironguards attached to that crawler will be destroyed as well. 

Support Crawler NV is also able to launch a scarab shield. Activate the ability on the crawler and launch it at a location in an AOE. All Ironguard in the radius will gain a scarab armor protection that provides them with additional 1 off shield for 60 seconds.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/b82ab7d8a5d4b067d64c925b3a85b6c9148b7ab6.png[/img]

[*] [b]AXR Energy Division receives Support Crawler SV-2 Unit[/b]
When deployed Support Crawler SV-2 will generate a dome shield that protects its allies inside it. Support Crawler SV-2 also has a shield health that will regenerate after not taking damage for a certain amount of time. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/9a535e7fc5551f68908113c40976713ae6dacdfc.png[/img]

[*] [b]AXR Stealth Division receives Support Crawler PV Unit[/b]
Support Armament Crawler Stealth able to and spawn scout projections at a targeted area around it when its deployed. It is also able to deploy 3 mines which will be ejected from its back. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/135e36debdb62405d55efc33013060b88ab1b6a3.png[/img]
[/list]

[h1]Battlesuit Balance Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Covert Vanguard is now able to deploy stealth wall at a stationary position instead of carrying it around
[*] Aegis shield reduced from 150% to 130%
[*] Assault Vanguard "CAMG Homing" rocket damage increased by 30% from 500 to 650
[*] Assault vanguard "CAMG Homing" cooldown increased by 30% from 6 seconds to 7.8 seconds
[*] Exploit Vanguard now will siphon a fixed amount of resource
[/list]

[h1]Artillery Strike Commander Ability Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Armor General will not have Artillery Strike Commander Ability but now will be replaced with the ‘Bombing Run’ ability
[/list]

[h1]Specialist Revamp[/h1]
[list]
[*] Specialist production cost reduced from 650/150/0 to 650/100/0
[*] Specialist will now require Tier 3 upgraded research module to be built, where before they will only need a Tier 2 research module to be built.
[/list]
Specialist are now able to upgrade to:
[list]
[*] AMPAW package upgrade (AMPAW + EMP) with the ability Throw AEG Grenade command has 50 seconds cooldown[/list]
Or
[list][*] Tactical Package upgrade with a flashbang attachment that will fire a mini flashbang every 1.5 seconds when in combat and coupled with a Ballistic Damage reduction buff
[*] Specialist are now immune to flash
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/007a42ca2de894134665b6c1063290fa850df874.png[/img]

[h1]Specialist Strike Team revamp[/h1]
[list]
[*] Energy Specialist Strike Team is able to fire a single target laser that splits and splashes to other nearby units within its range
[*] AXR Stealth Division's Specialist Strike Team will have a strafing run type of ability (Flash Cluster) that players can use in a straight like. Ability will consists of 2 parts (Firing a row of flashbangs first then firing cluster grenades in a straight line). Firing method is similar to MLRS and will equip MRPG when using this ability.
[/list]

[h1]Resource Point Depreciation[/h1]
[list]
[*] Energy Capture Point resource change from 2 Credits, 5 Energy and 0 Supply to 0 Credits, 5 Energy and 0 Supply
[*] Supply Capture Point resource change from 2 Credits, 0 Energy and 6 Supply to 0 Credits, 0 Energy and 6 Supply

The more resource points capture the higher the depreciation will be. Ratio for all points are listed below.

[h3]Credit Capture Point ratio :[/h3]
    [*] 1 : 1.0
    [*] 2 : 0.7
    [*] 3 : 0.6
    [*] 4 : 0.5
    [*] 5 : 0.4
    [*] 6 : 0.3
    [*] 7 : 0.2
    [*] 8 : 0.15
    [*] 9 : 0.1
    [*] 10 : 0.1
[h3]Energy Capture Point ratio :[/h3]
    [*] 1 : 1.0
    [*] 2 : 0.7
    [*] 3 : 0.3
[h3]Supply Capture Point ratio :[/h3]
    [*] 1 : 1.0
    [*] 2 : 0.7
    [*] 3 : 0.3
[h3]Power Reactor and Power Plant ratio :[/h3]
    [*] 1 : 1.0
    [*] 2 : 0.6
    [*] 3 : 0.4
    [*] 4 : 0.2

[*] Power Reactor and Power Plant default resource change from 3 energy to 5 energy
[*] Secured Resource Point now will not double the resource but +2 on the resource node
[*] Resource Panel UI will now show resource rate details while hovering over it
[/list]

[h1]Gameplay Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] AXR AEG Grenade EMP duration is reduced from 8 seconds to 5 seconds
[*] Service Ironguard is now removed from production and is now part of the Robotics support Crawler instead
[*] Service Ironguard Population consumption reduced from 7 to 0
[*] APC is now available for every division
[*] AXR Structure vehicle when undeployed now are not able to stealth
[*] APC has been revamped. All APC will now able to deploy and supply weapons to officers
[*] Infantry General APC’s will also have an additional ability where it is able to heal any units around the APC
[*] AXR Templar requirement is now changed to require TCU
[/list]

[h1]Balance Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Support Crawler Projector project phantom assault will now check Line of Sight (LOS)
[*] Support Crawler cost adjusted from 2600/900 to 2500/1100
[*] Elite Marine Pop cap decreased from 8 to 6
[*] EMP Grenade usage decreased from 2 to 1
[*] Strafing Run now will fire at any desired area
[*] Deployable APS will will be deactivate while getting EMPed
[*] Changed Ironguard activate protocol to Order Single Unit Only
[*] APC cost reduced from 3200/1000 to 2500/900
[*] IFV cost reduced from 3200/1000 to 2800/750
[*] Crawler cost adjusted from 2600/900 to 2800/750
[*] Advanced Armored Logistics, MCU, RCU, TCU upgrade energy cost increased from 2200 to 3000
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed issue with Marines in formation after throwing grenade causing it to break formation
[*] Fixed issue with When exiting commander mode while hovering mouse over an enemy unit as a commander will reveal them permanently (only to commander)
[*] PVP Harlem/Town Square base placement for Ai GSF updated
[*] Fixed issue with Exit commander mode while hovering mouse over an enemy unit as a commander will reveal them permanently (only to commander)
[*] Fixed ACADEMY PVP floating banners
[*] Fixed issue where it displays Inaccurate Rate of Fire value in RTS HUD due to wrong rounding
[*] Fixed Central and Crossing floating objects
[*] Fixed issue with Marines in formation after throwing grenade break formation
[*] PVP Harlem/Town Square base placement for Ai GSF
[*] Fixed issue Tutorial Vehicle Spawn in firing range sinks in ground
[*] Fixed issue with AXR Structure making it rotate too fast
[*] Exploit Vanguard now will siphon a fixed amount of resource
[*] Fixed issue Command with cost on selection group will execute for every unit selected even though it is not sufficient for every unit selected
[*] Fixed issue on Central near Base 1 wall there is navigation under the building that causes AI to get stuck
[*] Fixed an issue where some of the GSF Structure navigation doesn't block which causes infantry units to get stuck
[*] Fixed issue with Academy Building LOD
[*] Lowered down Chromatic aberration for post process effect when receiving shield damage
[*] Adjusted Air Craft attenuation sound
[/list]

[h1]Localization[/h1]
Updated localization for:
[list]
[*] Russian
[*] German
[*] Chinese Simplified
[*] Chinese Traditional
[/list]

[h1]Brand New Cosmetics and Premium Cosmetics Shop![/h1]
There is now a new Premium tab in the store where players can access a higher tier premium cosmetic. To purchase these cosmetics you will need "Eden Core" which will be sold in multiple variation.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/ecf97bdea97681bcaba38ef6bde2314c3c4907a6.png[/img]

The Premium Store includes 6 Premium Packs (3 GSF and 3 AXR), 4 Premium Callsigns, and 10 New Unique Victory Poses. So do check them out.

These packs however like previously will require players to equip them to gain exp as they play to unlock the higher tier skins, callsigns Frames and Banners.

notes.title: Eximius - Season 2 'Spring Rumble' (NA)
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/9055ff8e45b37275dd3cf70a73f10ee776ab2a3d.jpg[/img]

We are excited to announce Eximius - Season 2 'Spring Rumble' (NA) will be on 7th - 8th May. This is a [u][b]North America Region[/b][/u] tournament with a Prize Pool of USD1,500.  While anyone is allowed to join, North America region means that the server and timing will be catered to North America, using Eastern Time(ET) as main timezone.  For the first time ever, we will also be limiting the veterancy of each team to give a stronger chance for new players to participate. 

[b]Team Point System[/b]
Each team will be given a maximum 10 veterancy-points Limit. Each member can carry from 0 to 3 points depending on their veterancy that is determined in the list below. 
[list]
[*] A member for team ranked 1st or 2nd in any previous tournament (Invitational Excluded) - 3 Points
[*] A member for team ranked 3rd or 4th in any previous tournament (Invitational Excluded) - 2 Points
[*] Over Level 30 Ingame Player Level - 1 Points
[*] Not in any of the category above - 0 Points
[/list]
[i]Note: 
[list]
[*] Point criteria do not stack. ( i.e if you are a 3-point player, your level does not matter )
[*] We're allowing incomplete teams to register and participate - minimum of 2 players (1 Commander, 1 Officer)
[/list][/i]

[previewyoutube=GTVs5LHoR54;full][/previewyoutube]

Prepare your team and mark the date.

[h3]Match Timing[/h3]
ET: 9AM - 3PM
PT: 6AM - 12PM
UTC: 1PM - 7PM
MYT/AWST: 9PM - 3AM

Registration and Rulebook as of 5th April 2022
Registration Link: [url=https://forms.gle/4QD1C9E4NhVFey4FA]Google Form[/url]
Rule Book: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/505740/discussions/3/3132792921893476493/]Steam Post[/url], [url=https://drive.google.com/file/d/11xOdadZILxSoApWyqSJnm7KRhVBWNU4O/view?usp=sharing]PDF Download[/url]

Looking for a team to join up with? Join in on our official discord server!

notes.title: Eximius 1.1.5 Update - 22nd December 2021
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/f1431163a932ba3d224182fcaf73344fb2ce3bc0.png[/img]

[h2][Event][/h2]
[list]
[*] Winter Warfare event started 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/722f078782043f1d191d7be6eaa96f51f1c410e8.png[/img]
[/list][b]Full Winter Warfare event details can be seen here[/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/505740/view/5609794375985049992

[h2][New Feature][/h2]
[h3]New Team Skirmish Advance Settings[/h3]
A new advance settings for Team Skirmish has been added to the game. This option will give players access to multiple different customization settings. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/3d1e09998c0f4cefaf0a36ceb475cfc454166c21.png[/img]

This option is turned off by default and has to be enabled to be used. DO NOTE that turning on this option will [i]disable any EXP gained and Contracts for the duration of the match[/i].
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/e0bf9f02936eb5731eaa18ca4b69859f74d7a0d0.png[/img]

Rooms with Advance Settings enabled will have a "NO EXP" Icon on the top indicating the room will not provide any EXP and contract progression as well as a warning prompt when joining in an advance setting match.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/ebf98e960c1e3fa7a5d4f99cb9597f7f6759f8ec.png[/img]


[h2][Improvements][/h2]
[h3]Improved Attack Commands[/h3]
[list]
[*] Infantry Attack Move and Priority Attack is now combined into one function [/list]
Orders a selected unit to attack a target unit or location. When used on location, light infantry will move in tactically, advancing when it's safe. If this command is used on heavy infantry it will prioritize attacking that target instead.

[list]
[*] Vehicles Priority Attack and Attack Ground is now combined into one function[/list]
Orders a selected vehicle to attack a location or a prioritize specific target, when use on ground, it will fire at the target area and if used on a specific unit, it will prioritize it's weapon to fire at the unit whenever possible but will not move from its current location. Priority Attack/Attack Ground key for vehicles has also been remapped to the "F" key instead of "P"
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/6b9d25c8686f7f7fa3a4d137597a22141f3c4bcc.gif[/img]


[h3]Infantry Grenade and Explosive pack auto throw Behavior[/h3]
Marines and Elite Marines will now automatically throw their grenades during combat when in a range of a hostile target. GSF will still require to research "Infantry Equipment Upgrade" for them to throw grenades.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/71f292f5c5034f8bf9cde7141d7fa8e481183c39.gif[/img] 

Demolishes are now also able throw their explosive packs when near enemy structure and vehicles.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/fdc9a20131eb5a1c8cdf0b10408c3a531be37a5a.gif[/img]

[h2][Weapon Balance Changes][/h2]
[h3]MRPG changes[/h3][list]
[*] MRPG now have danger indication of 3 meters that will prevent players from firing at a close range
[*] Minimum range is increased from 5 meters to 10 meters
[*] Impact damage is reduced from 650 to 550
[*] Splash damage is reduced from 650 to 550
[*] Splash radius is reduced from 6m to 4m
[/list]

[h2][Other Balance Changes][/h2]
[list]
[*] Added Secured MULE's gibs, Secured MULE when destroyed will now spawn its destroyed frame allowing for Siege Vanguard to salvage
[*] Covert Vanguard "Execute" passive ability "to not be spotted" requirement is removed
[*] Removed Specialist Strike Team Laser Aiming Indicator
[/list]
[h2][Fixes][/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue with MRPG sometimes doesn't explode when reached the targeted distance
[*] Fixed an issue with Deployed MULE when issued revive order won't undeploy and execute the order
[*] Fixed an issue in the tutorial during the destroy vehicle in tutorial the player is able to interact with the tutorial console to spawn another vehicle.  
[*] Fixed an issue with Covert Vanguard after performing an execution the player will get stuck
[*] Fixed an issue with Crawler's turret not applying stealth material when it is not relevant
[*] Fixed an issue with G12 Guided while Aim Down Sight and switch weapon the aim indicator will stay
[*] Fixed an issue with GSF Reinforcement Tier 3 vehicle will squash reinforcement infantries
[*] Added fixed length for Laser Strike
[/list]

[h2]Enjoy the Update and Merry Christmas!![/h2]

notes.title: Winter Event - Winter Warfare
notes.notes:
[b]Merry Christmas Officers![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/9eac3b04d252ca32737c65437ee75fb19072fe4a.png[/img]

The Winter season has taken over the battlefield. Participate in the special public Winter games to earn exclusive prizes this winter season. 

Lookout for these special public winter rooms to participate in the event and join in to win exclusive prizes.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/11929269d8aafacbdde60abfee228e987f6b2b59.png[/img]

Joining these rooms will bring you to a familiar map with the new snowy weather, present boxes can also be found scattered around resource and victory points during this special game mode. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/78a0962151de37ec2f5a5a161316fdeeca0a7eb1.png[/img]


[u][h2] Event Rewards [/h2][/u]
Collecting said present boxes will earn you and your allies candies that you can use to trade for Exclusive items in the event store

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/c7977ce092aff9954a5c3c138cdf3ce1c5c3d458.png[/img]

There are 2 Types of present boxes. A small variant that when collected will gain you 15 candies per box and a larger one that gives 50 candies per box to you and your allies. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/7c5a40f66155fd9d710d231e5fd2bf9d3bcff192.png[/img]

Do note that a max of 40 boxes can be found in each match with only 8 being active at all times and when collected another present box will spawn in 30 seconds at a random resource or victory point. 

Additionally, winning a game will get you an extra 500 candies but do not fret if you lose as you will still receive 200 candies for your troubles in each winter event match.

In summary, below are the ways to obtain the candies.
 - Winning a winter event match = 500 Candies
 - Losing  a winter event match  = 200 Candies
 - Each Large Present Box = 50 Candies
 - Each Small Present Box = 15 Candies

[i]Note: Only by winning the match will you receive the extra candies obtained from the present boxes and any previously obtained event exclusive currency will be converted to in-game credits with a 1:1 conversion.[/i]

This event will be available from [b]22nd December to 5th January[/b] [i](2 Weeks)[/i].
Enjoy the event and have a Merry Christmas!

Along with this event, update 1.1.5 is also going live. Don't forget to check out the changes/fixes on the link here :

notes.title: Eximius 1.1.4 Minor Update - 24th November 2021
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/dc7d4ff3b61837a13101a635b5be5e6c40ccbdcb.png[/img]
Greetings Officers,
A minor balance change and bug fix patch has been released. Below are the details for the patch.

[h2][Balance Changes][/h2]
[list]
[*] All Artillery tanks ability cooldowns is increased to 48 seconds from 30 seconds
[*] AXR Demolisher train cost reduced to 380 / 70 from 450 / 100 
[*] Viper's abilities now will have separate cooldown
[*] Shockwave damage per shot is decreased to 70 from 83
[/list]
[b]Cyclone HWS's Artillery is now revamped[/b]
[list]
[*]All cyclone ability shots takes slightly longer to hit its target. It will take 1.2 seconds to ascend (from 0.75 seconds) and will fall from a height of 300m at 60m/s ( up from 150m )
[*]Each Precision Strike shots will fired in a 1.2 second interval. 
[*]Cyclone Heavy Artillery (Reserve Munition) damage increased to 2500 explosive damage over 20m splash from 1500 damage over 8m
[*]Precision strike and Heavy artillery now has a distinct incoming sound. 
[*]All cyclone shots will now have ambient sound effects that can be heard globally
[/list]
[b]AXR Structure build time changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Power Reactor build time decrease to 20 seconds from 27
[*] Fabricator build time decrease to 27 seconds from 33
[*] AXR Turret build time decrease to 20 seconds from 30
[/list]
[h2][Visual][/h2]
[list]
[*]Adjusted mortar trail VFX to make it more visible for RTS
[/list]
[h2][Fixes][/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue with MULE heal command description mention Field Support
[*] Fixed an issue with Marine and Demolisher throw grenade / explosive pack command won't work if selected target is an unit
[*] Fixed an issue with GSF Armory taking extra damage from splash due to armory modules.
[*] Adjusted AXR Command Center mesh
[*] Fixed an issue with Cyclone Precision Strike command description says fire 2 rounds instead of 4 rounds
[/list]

[*] Standardized guardian trooper's movement speed
[*] All light infantries are now able to capture any Victory or Resource points
[*] Implemented Priority Target command to Guardian Trooper
[*] Removed Heavy Weapon De-buff from Demolishers when they are equipping a G-12
[/list]

[h2][Vehicle Balance Changes][/h2]
[list]
[*] All Transporter Vehicles APC and Crawler will now automatically eject passengers when its destroyed
[*] Crawler HP increased to 6200 from 5800 for all variants
[*] All Artillery tanks command cooldown is reduced to 30 seconds from 60 seconds
[*] Turning on Stealth Mode on Stealth Crawler will not put the ability on cooldown
[*] Unboarding units with Stealth Crawler will not unstealth it
[*] Turrets on Crawler and M33 will not take damage
[/list]

[h2][Commander Balance Changes][/h2]
[list]
[*] Elite Marine now available to train in any Barracks but requires at least one Advanced Barracks
[*] Cyclone HWS is now able to be built in Armored Logistics regardless of its Tier but still requires at least 1 built Tier 3 Structure
[*] Armory will now automatically secure any resource point when placed near it
[*] Secured Resource Point command is now free
[*] Weapon Crew Move command shortcut key is changed to "M"

[*] Echelon Air Countermeasure upgrade command Icon on Echelon Support Crew will now always show but is grayed out if the tech is not researched
[*] Ocular defense Defensive Bombardment cooldown is reduced to 25 seconds from 45 seconds
[/list]

[h2][Other Balance Changes][/h2]
[list]
[*] Anti-Tank damage multiplier to light vehicle reduced to 1.8 from 2.0
[*] Armor Piercing damage multiplier to Heavy infantry reduced by 20%
[*] Increased Viper Claw distance travel to 35m  from 20m
[/list]

[h2][UI Improvements][/h2]
[list]
[*] Laser Strike will have Artillery warning in the commander view
[*] Incendiary rounds command now will show targeted location and predicted hit location
[/list]

[h2][Bug Fixes][/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue with Crawler Support Armament doesn't regenerate shield until shield is expanded and retracted at least once
[*] Fixed an issue with Crawler Support Armament mesh disappears when looking at the extended parts
[*] Fixed an issue with Crawler Support Armament Armory Weapons does not disappear when picked up
[*] Fixed an issue with Crawler Support Armament Armory Weapons can be picked up again even though player had just equipped the weapon
[*] Fixed an issue with the Unlock Screen as it doesn't display the correct preview for Medals
[*] Fixed an issue in the Intel section armor type typo
[*] Fixed an issue with Siege Vanguard ability tip in loading screen shows able to place 2 turrets instead of 3 turrets
[*] Fixed an issue with Players able to see their own head when entering GSF Battlesuit Pod sequence
[*] Fixed an issue with The rotation of the camera sometimes is not correct when entering AXR Battlesuit Forging Drone sequence
[*] Fixed chat box overlapping issue
[*] Fixed an issue with Laser Strike Beam that does not disappear even after it stops firing
[*] Fixed an issue with Covert execute not working when executing an enemy while stealth wall is on 
[*] Fixed an issue with Battle-Pass screen shows incorrect player currency balance when pack is not unlocked
[*] Fixed a Critical issue with Upgrade Tech that causes commander to not upgrade anything.
[*] Fixed an issue where LMG Warthog HE Round explosion if damaged enemy units and the user is not spotted the enemy will ignore the user
[*] Sunday Mall GSF Team 0 GSF Armored Logistic base placement fix
[*] Fixed an issue with AI Officer having multiple of the same weapons 
[*] Fixed an issue with Hellspawn no longer point flame turret down after target dies 
[*] Fixed an issue with Weapon crew deployment teleport if issue deploy command at different location while unpacking weapon started 
[*] Fixed an issue with Covert Vanguard after using execute, weapon will have multiple attachments overlapping
[*] Fixed an issue where Targeted strike will deal damage twice to Crawler

notes.title: Halloween Event - Harbingers Return
notes.notes:
Trick or Treat Officers, Happy Halloween.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/5a93e05a6e9c859d33529b0bb52aeba00ff7fc10.png[/img]
[u][h2]  The story so far [/h2][/u] 
HARBGRS [i] (Hivemind Automation for Recycling, Building-maintenance, Governance, Repairs and Sanitation)[/i] nick-named [i]Harbinger-system[/i]s , was once an experimental AI that services entire metropolitan. The core purpose was a massive system that brings to life wide array of machinery and resources to function on a single purpose of maintaining city-wide infrastructures. 

When these futuristic cities fell to the anarchists, the AI lost control of their primary directive.
In a bid to gain balance in the chaos, it's sub-system evolved violent means to sanitize the city of all major lifeforms. It is unknown what new directives it has given itself.

The rogue AI has now taken over Axeron assets and has integrated biological warfare components to its arsenal of weapons. With the use of powerful hallucinogens, it has created an army that blurs the line between what's real and what's not. These abominations now march across the lands. They must be stopped at all cost.

[u][h2] How to Play [/h2][/u] 
Participate in these 3 special Halloween PVE modes to earn exclusive rewards. During the entire duration of this event, Co-op missions will be replaced. You can earn special candy currency while on these missions to purchase the new event-exclusive cosmetics. 

[h3][b]URBAN APOCALYPSE[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/c64960f7d9a44affcba5e269282358c1fd5de889.jpg[/img]
The harbingers are finally here with their forces to disrupt our mission to gather data.
We need to stop them. Eliminate the harbingers, deliver their heads to our base for further analysis. 

[h3][b]HOMELAND HORROR[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/0a0cfec9e68a664f0b774425a9be5fa9590b948b.jpg[/img]
Our defensive lines are being targeted by waves of possessed raiders. The SAM sites prevent the arrival of more harbingers. Do not lose them or there will be a heavy price to pay.

[h3][b]CARGO OF DEATH[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/f8aee9041419fadddf6701fce3ced7237c7c19e9.jpg[/img]
Our security forces escorting Olympus Convoy has been targeted as well. Keep your eyes open, expect assault from the harbingers as we approach extraction points.


[u][h2] Event Rewards [/h2][/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/1ffc0232ce9ba56556e7d6055f5e094e6a528e7a.jpg[/img]
The sinister pumpkins have returned. Collect these orange ornates and gather the sweet treats within to earn event exclusive goodies. Remember, higher difficulty spawns higher value pumpkins. 

Here are how you can obtain these lovely candies:
- Mission victory : 200 Candies
- Mission defeat : 100 Candies
- Each sinister Pumpkin : 5 candies
- Special sinister Pumpkin : 50 candies

These candy currency allow you to purchase items on the [i] Event Store[/i].

These missions will be available from [b]28th October to 11th November[/b] [i](2 Weeks)[/i].

[h2]Additional Intel[/h2]
Learn how to deal with the 4 Horsemen of apocalypse; War, Pestilence, Famine and Death in the videos below : 
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vAte0VRGokQ
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5_Bc2EJEQzs

Along with this event, update 1.1.2 is also going live. Don't forget to check out the changes/fixes on the link here :
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/505740/view/3077640948778003351

notes.title: Eximius 1.1.2 Update - 28th October 2021
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/04b7a250bd460318798840045026bf220bdc025e.png[/img]

[h3][Event][/h3]
[list]
[*] Harbingers Return event started 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/5a93e05a6e9c859d33529b0bb52aeba00ff7fc10.png[/img]
[/list][b]Full Harbinger Return event details can be seen here[/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/505740/view/3077640948781082805

[h2][Improvements / Changes][/h2]
[list]

[h3]General Officer(FPS) Gameplay [/h3][*] Max weapon Credits for players increased to 4500 from 3000
[*] Increased all battlesuit cost to 3000 from 2500

[h3]General Commander(RTS) Gameplay [/h3] [*] Commander can now issue Set Goal command to human officer and an icon will show up in the officer screen to indicate the goal location. This helps to communicate team goals. 
[*] Added scatter command to scatter selected infantry units.
[*] Extended self-destruct button for infantry as well to dispose of unwanted units.
[*] Suppression-pinned down retreat behavior for infantry is now removed. Suppression still discourage attack-move units from advancing.
[*] Heavy-infantry ( Ironguards & Guardian Trooper )  now has dual combat behavior. While using Attack-move, they will adjust position to attack. But when issue stop command (X-key), they will stay in position. 
[*] Changed power reactor shortcut key to P

[h3]Viper[/h3] [*] Viper can how drag enemy officer all the way to the front even while alive. Turning it into a very deadly ability that can disrupt enemy position.
[*] Viper's charged claw will now lock enemy battlesuit ability as well.

[h3] SATM Seeker Package [/h3] [*] Reduced SATM Seeker's projectile damage to have the same damage as the normal SATM
[*] SATM Seeker now can only fire one projectile at a time. UI has changed to reflect this.
[*] SATM Seeker rounds will now fire in a more natural path and will speed up when it descends. The result of this change means you require a higher clearance area for the initial launch up location.

[/list] 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/4f68af022e6671efb38b2f12a4c6c25be190179d.gif[/img]

[h2][Map Improvements][/h2]
[list]
[*] Removed all instances of resource point being able to be secured from inside the base using power reactor.
[*] [b]TOWN SQUARE : [/b] Removed a few tall buildings near 'C' point that blocks play area.
[*] [b]TOWN SQUARE : [/b] Extend shortcut to A and C point to the middle road.
[*] [b]SUNDAY MALL : [/b] Adjusted path on B/C lane and changed resource points so that lockdown armory no longer block paths. 
[*] [b]SUNDAY MALL : [/b] Added Rooftop access to Victory point B and C in Sunday Mall
[*] Readjusted certain resource points in Crossing due to distance imbalance
[/list]
[b]Full Dev Stream of the new PVP map changes can be see here[/b]
https://youtu.be/6QdR7UET-Pw?t=2074

[h2][Balance Changes][/h2]
[list]

[h3] Weapon Balance [/h3]
[*] SiGAR & XM13 Marksman package range has been increase to 120m
[*] XM45 Mag package Clip size is now the same as base weapon. 
[*] XM45 Mag package Fire rate decrease by 20% instead of 50% .
[*] MRPG Cluster package price increased to 1500 from 500
[*] ESP (Emergency Shield Pack) price reduced to 400 from 750
[*] S1911-Sidekick price reduced to 600 from 800
[*] ZC9-Handcannon price reduced to 600 from 800
[*] AntiTank mines increase to 3 quantity. Price increased to 1200 from 1000
[*] UA9 High Capacity package spread and recoil reduced significantly.
[*] G12 Guided package now has 1500 splash damage with regular falloff.
[*] Increased MASER and CPC cost to 3000 from 2500
[*] Shockwave now will fire more traces, increased impact damage to 83 from 70. While the DPS for max damage is still the same, it allows for more consistent spread damage. 
[*] Removed critical damage bonus from Shockwave but base value increased to match the original dps.

[h3] Other Balance changes[/h3]
[*] Recon Toolkit build time is reduced to 5 seconds from 30 
[*] Marine cost credit is dropped to 360 from 400
[*] Engineer credit cost drop to 250 from 300
[*] FREE units for GSF for first barracks is changed to 6 Marine + 1 Phalanx from 10 marines
[*] GSF Phalanx Crew cost reduced to 2200/300/0 from 2400/300/0
[*] Guardian Trooper cost reduced to 2600/1100/0 from 2600/1600/0
[*] Elite Marine cost changed to 750/150/0 from 650/200/0
[*] Specialist cost reduced to 650/150/0 from 800/200/0
[*] Elite Marine Weapon Upgrade command is now a production with a 5 seconds production time
[*] Selecting a group of Elite Marines and upgrading their weapon will now only upgrade 1 of the elite marine in the group instead of all
[*] Harlem Protocol Mortar Crew will have limit based on the difficulty (Easy & Normal = 1, Hard = 2, Brutal = 3)
[*] Updated Harlem Protocol unit threshold (Easy 30 to 50, Normal 50 to 60, Hard 87 to 85)
[*] Ironguard damage and fire-rate decreased to 70dmg with 13.3rounds/sec from 80dmg with 14.28rounds/sec. (Total DPS decrease to 931 from 1142)
[*] Ironguard price increased to 2000 from 1800
[*] Guardian trooper will now only heavy flinch when hit by anti-tank. Explosive and high damage bullet will only do light flinch.
[*] Hyperion Defensive Drone ability cooldown increase from 1s to 3s
[*] Adjusted time required for Cyclone Precision Strike's projectiles to reach its target location to almost the same as Barrage Strike

[*] Precious Cargo cargo transport time is increased by 30%

[/list]
[h3][Bug Fixes][/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue with Engineer repair animation won't stop even after order is canceled and when issuing another order right after engineer plays repair animation
[*] Fixed the offset for Divine arms frames
[*] Fixed an issue with Attack Ground command that bypass AI lock (For example, EMPed vehicle will still fire at the ground)
[*] Fixed an issue with Attack Ground won't reset priority target
[*] Fixed Bus Mesh and Removed one way window glass 
[*] Fixed an issue with the FPS hand would go missing when holding a weapon in a battle suit
[*] Fixed car clipping issue in Express
[*] Fixed an issue with Viper ability animation stuck when when toggling ability and entering into RTS mode
[*] Fixed an issue with Aegis Super Charge beam when hitting an Ironguard just after it dies will still show successful heal message
[*] Fixed an issue in Challenge level will spawn the player twice and sometimes even will have floating weapons or enemy that will shoot at the invisible officer
[*] Fixed an issue with Orion's passive when deactivated under a Phantom Drone will become unstealth
[*] Fixed an issue with Guardian Trooper wrong build source in the Intel Menu
[*] Fixed an issue with certain vehicles disappearing when its at the corner of player screen
[*] Fixed an issue with Hybrid Alloy armor showing inaccurate description of bonuses
[*] Fixed an issue with Stealth Crawler turret that does not apply the stealth material if a player joins in half way of the match while Stealth Crawler is in stealth
[*] Fixed an issue with AXR Command Centre still having some navmesh underneath it causing Officer to teleport underneath it
[*] Fixed an issue with rejoin button not displaying in the Pre-game lobby
[*] Fixed an issue with Spectator able to go out of map bounds
[*] Fixed an issue  while under the Phantom Drone and purchasing an ISW package upgrade, the attachments are stealth but the weapon is not. 
[*] Fixed chat message box overlapping RTS panel
[*] Fixed an issue with Pre-Game Lobby session is not cleared when the match ends
[*] Fixed an issue with the interaction disappearing in a high ping environment 
[/list]
[h2]Enjoy the Update and Happy Halloween!![/h2]

notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/c21e7941e80f6109c78e7afb826900c7685503a1.png[/img]
Greetings Officers, this update features a few RTS camera improvements mainly with the rotation and keybindings as well as UI improvements and a few balance changes. We're exited to see your reaction and feedback for these improvements and changes.

In this patch, player's level experience has been adjusted to follow a newer calculation. Your player level will increase but to compensate for your credits lost everyone will be given a special event contract by playing 1 online match to gain 4000 credits with no time limit attached. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/023697a97dc9c4b3fb7c3c4aad2c98c4fcafada1.png[/img]

[h1]1.1.1 Changelog[/h1]

[h2]RTS Camera Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added Ability to Re-bind Rotate RTS Camera to any Key Shortcut
[*] Added RTS Camera Rotation Sensitivity in the Control Settings
[*] Added Separate Reset RTS Camera Rotation Key assigned to "Backspace"
[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/dde5b0f248d3b520557d3a56fdf6f8dbfbebb041.png[/img]

[h2]Officer UI Improvements[/h2]
We have made a couple of changes to the Officer UI by removing the previous officer icon that was not informative to players and instead replaced it with the player's callsign icon to distinguish between officers better. Also we've added a compact Officer Unit indicator for when officers are far from the sight of the player to reduce overall screen clutter. Do let us know what do you think about this change. 
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/babeea7da1895a776ac92d9487c8f342c7d3d4cf.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/22f69e56646ad7f3243519e2d4504a3159ba578c.png[/img]

[list]

notes.title: Season 2 Hotfix (v1.1.0a)
notes.notes:
Greetings Officers,

We have identified and fixed several issues thanks to your feedback and reports. We have implemented a Fix for several of these issues. The issues identified and fixed are listed down below.

- Fixed Issue with power reactor permanently locking resource points even after it has been destroyed. 
- Covert Vanguard's Pulse Scanner charge will continue to deplete even is not active when toggling it rapidly
- Fixed issue with Covert Vanguard Stealth wall will be up even after knock down and will go into FPS view with stealth wall on
- Fixed issue with Intel page weapon critical damage multiplier is not showing correctly
- Fixed issue with the wrong Ironguard Drop ability description in Intel division section
- Fixed Recon Grenade model viewer not appearing in the Intel section for both GSF and AXR
- Fixed issue Viper unable to pick-up Urban Hustle objective case
- Fixed Seige Vanguard HAMR is able to hit Hyperion's APS
- Viper Charged Claw now will reduce Officer movement speed when attached to enemy officer
- Fixed Manic Victory pose that is causing the hand to jitter. 
- Fixed Issue with the RTS cursor unable to interact or becomes invalid when selecting certain resource points.
- Twilight Lighting has been disabled temporarily as its causing performance issues. (We will further investigate this issue) 

We will continue to monitor for any issues. If you have encountered any bugs feel free to report it at our discord channel where you can also meet fellow officers and commanders.

[url=https://discord.gg/uNUrqdmed5]Join Ammobox Studios Discord[/url]

[h2]Nemesis Trailer[/h2]
[previewyoutube=X_HdYWdr7Os;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Nemesis Update Changelog[/h1]

[h2]Town Square[/h2]
A new map has been added to the Eximius making this the 6th map in the game. This place used to be a place of gathering for social activities, now we are here for the blood of our enemies.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/f3e83e127f854bcea909c09740498f7f48c4259a.png[/img]

[h2]2 New Battlesuits[/h2]
[h3]Axeron "Viper"[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/fd981930f0d8edfc69b44e1b8156ebd88501d078.jpg[/img] 

[h3]GSF "Covert Vanguard"[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/a0e97ace547e4f6de6fcf22a3f30ab59ea1e01f2.jpg[/img]

[h2]12 New Weapon Packages[/h2]
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fEdJaQMv2FM
[list]
[*] SIGAR "Spec Ops Package"
[*] UA9 "High Capacity Package"
[*] IGL “Superfrag Package”
[*] ATR "Fire Spear Package"
[*] Warthog "Armor Piercing Package"
[*] Warthog "High Explosives Package"
[*] SATM "Seeker Package"
[*] XM13 "Marksman Package"
[*] AMPAW "Modulated Package"
[*] ISW "Impact Rounds Package"
[*] ISW "Armor Piercing Package"
[*] G12 "Guided Package"
[/list]

[h2]Faction gameplay & technology changes[/h2]
[h3]GSF - All Divisions[/h3]
[list]
[*] IFV and M33 will now be available for every GSF division
[*] Building your first Barracks will now give players 10 free marines
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/f315a410893a13738e9040d8194fe51d86f4d539.gif[/img]

Implemented new reserved munitions for GSF vehicles :
[list]
[*] Cyclone : Heavy Artillery Round
[*] M34 : Super napalm
[*] IF & APC : Armor piercing rounds
[*] Lancer : Explosive round
[*] Ballista : EMP Rounds
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/52540a665a8b787e01d56307d5ddc5afa88cf711.gif[/img]

[h3]GSF Fortification Division[/h3]
[list]
[*] Defensive Countermeasure is no longer a commander ability but instead its a communication centre’s ability. The jamming location can be changed manually from the communication centre.
[*] Echelon Crew’s ACM (Air Counter-measures) is now reworked. It can now be individually purchased on the Echelon crew at the cost of 1500 supplies. Deploying APS mode will now by default have the ACM mode activated. This ACM upgrade is still locked behind a paid upgrade on the unit itself.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/ce6722f98d0a525c80e70afb9adb0e44b99c19e4.gif[/img]

[h3]Axeron - All Divisions[/h3]
[list]
[*] EMP Strike is now an ability that automatically unlocks on Tier-3 ( any branch ) without additional research.
[*] The Mechanized computing unit (MCU) has a new upgrade (repair drone enhancement) that improves the duration and repair speed of the repair drone.
[*] MULE now can heal organic infantry, will auto heal infantry nearby, if heal target is moving too far away or after done healing MULE will go back to its original position
[*] Scout scanner is now able to scan a location in a radius (100m max range + supply cost 50) 
[*] Recon and Phantom Drone now has the ability to relocate its scanning area.
[*] Robotics computing unit (RCU) receives a new upgrade that reduces bullet damage of Ironguard by 33%.
[*] New Recon Toolkit Upgrade is now available giving scouts the option to scan and disable mines in a selected area.
[*] Constructing your first Fabricator will now give players 2 free Ironguards
[*] Omicron and Crawler will now be available for AXR Robotics and Energy division
[*] Stealth Crawler will now be available for AXR Stealth division
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/19fc0f3331f04f0cece29e2dd45f6f8355925ab0.gif[/img]

[h3]Axeron Energy Division[/h3]
[list]
[*] Overload command is now reworked. It is a toggle-able ability. When turned on, the damage linearly increases as the power output increases but can be cancelled anytime and has a cooldown before it is allowed to activate again. 
[*] Overload reactor can only be used on a secured power reactor (Power reactors that is currently locking down a resource point)
[*] Ocular Defense can now be upgraded to use bombardment ability. (Requires tier-3 any branch)
[*] Energy division received a new ability to overload weapons of Laser-equipped units. This requires a dedicated tier-3(any branch) research and a cost of supplies and energy upon activation. In addition to that, overloaded units will take damage while the effect lasts. Effects of using overload can be seen below:
[*] Overloaded Laser Knight : Overloaded knights fire the weapon continuously similar to an LMG. 
[*] Overloaded Ocular Defense : Increases damage dealt
[*] Overloaded Sigma Ocular : Increases damage dealt
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/c0112e943a1acc359f6dd74eade047dbe00689fd.gif[/img]

[h3]Axeron Stealth Division[/h3]
[list]
[*] Advanced Specialist’s cloaking module duration is increased by 30 seconds compared to the regular Specialist cloaking module.
[/list]

[h2]General Faction Balance Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Sigma Charged Shot is now an one-off use ability that has area effect explosion radiating through walls.
[*] Sigma Ocular Charged Shot is now a single-use ability that deals a large area-of-effect damage. It is now unlockable in MCU through research
[*] All railgun-type weapons will now bypass APS capabilities, currently affecting Sigma and Guardian Troopers.
[*] M34 Hellspawn's flamethrower won't be intercepted by APS now
[*] Field Support Heal is now allowed during combat
[*] Specialist range increased to 85m from 70m
[*] GSF Field Support and MULE can now revive Officers. When downed, the officer assigned with a field support or MULE will have a button to call for help
[*] Assigned field support can now be requested to heal squad leaders
[*] Added ability to Engineer & Scouts to defuse mines 
[*] Scout Jammer and Scout Scanner is only able to be used on a scout with a recon toolkit upgrade
[*] Support crawler now has 2 sets of armory modules instead of 4
[*] Increased healing beacon heal radius from 4m to 8m
[*] Increased healing beacon heal amount from 50 per second to 100 per second
[*] Decreased Healing Beacon cost from 150 supplies to 100 supplies
[*] Laser Knights no longer need to reload.
[*] Scanners such as Recon Drone, Phantom Drone, GSF Tactical Scanner will now mark deployable mines including Anti Armor Mine, Scarab, Shock Trap when scanned.
[*] Reduced the fire delay before GSF Cyclone fires significantly 
[*] Increased Reserved munition range to 90m from 50m for M33
[*] M33's Rocket Turret's AOE now has falloff of 1.0 exponent 
[*] M33's Rocket Turret turning is now limited to the front of the M33 turret
[*] Reduced M33's turret turning speed 
[*] Knight Ironguard cost change to 800/650 from 800/800
[*] Guardian Trooper price has been readjusted to 2800/1200 from 2600/1600
[*] Specialist cost reduced to 800/200 from 800/250
[*] Specialist training time reduced to 8s from 12s 
[*] Service Ironguard cost increased to 1200/200 from 1200/0 
[*] Echelon crew cost increased to 2400/400 from 2000/300
[*] Phalanx crew cost increased to 2400/250 from 1800/250 
[*] AXR vehicles now have a flat 24 seconds build time instead of 30 seconds. 
[*] Crawler cost readjusted to 2600/900 from 2000/1200
[*] IFV cost readjusted to 3200/1000 from 3500/1500
[*] Marine Combat Armor will no longer reduce damage from incendiary, armor piercing and slugs. 
[*] AXR Sigma charged shot is now able to target ground
[*] Incendiary damage now deals x3 damage to heavy infantry instead of x2.1
[*] Field Support resupply ammo pick up is now a tap instead of hold
[*] Blocks players from picking up weapon ammo or health when their health or ammo is full. 
[*] Omicron and Crawler will now be available for AXR Robotics and Energy Generals.
[*] IFV and M33 will now be available for every GSF sub faction
[*] Ironguard Drop commander ability is now changed to drop 4 Ironguard Core instead of 4 normal Ironguards.
[*] GSF Lancer energy cost reduced from 1500 to 1200
[*] GSF APC energy cost reduced from 1500 to 1000
[*] Credit point WPC increased from 3 to 4 
[*] Energy Point and Supplies Point WPC decreased from 7 to 4
[*] Base rate of WPC increased from 2 to 5
[/list]

[h2]Tier-3 light Infantry revamping[/h2]
[h3]Global Security Force (GSF)[/h3]
[list]
[*] GSF Elite marines no longer have random weapons. Now start with a light-machine gun.
[*] GSF Elite marines can be upgraded to grenade launchers or ATR rifles at the cost of supplies.
[*] Elite Marine default Movement Speed is decreased by 15%
[*] Elite marines will now occasionally do a dodge roll when aiming or firing at them.
[/list]
[h3]Axeron Industries (AXR)[/h3]
[list]
[*] AXR Specialists now have increased range ( 85m , up from 70m ) and are now the longest range light infantry.
[*] AXR Specialists can now cloak for a 30 seconds duration. This ability requires an extra upgrade on the tactical computing unit.
[*] AXR Specialists strike team is no longer limited to a single group and is permanently cloaked while deployed. 
[*] Specialist will now do a special dodge roll if fired grenade launcher at them
[/list]
[h3]Changes to AI sighting system[/h3]
[list]
[*] AI will now fire into soft-cover if the unit has been spotted by the team. 
[*] AI will not be able to spot units in soft cover if they’re not previously visible. However they are able to continue to maintain sight in it.
[*] However, if a target is spotted by another unit ( or via scan ) , AI will still shoot into soft-covers with less accuracy. 
[*] If you damage enemy units while in soft cover, AI will still blindly fire into it.
[/list]

[h2]Weapon / Equipment Balance changes[/h2]
[h3]New Weapons / Equipments[/h3]
[list]
[*] Recon grenades are now available. A throwable scanning grenade that marks enemy units through obstacles for the duration of the equipment’s time alive.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/2926d130a70c5181e6cadcb922029ceba39ce205.gif[/img]
[h3]Critical hits & damages multipliers[/h3]
[list]
[*] Bullets fired from players will now pierce through characters' limbs when detecting critical hits. This means the hands and arms no longer block shots supposed to land at the body. This resolves the issue where characters’ limbs would block critical shots to the body, inconsistently dropping the critical hits to non-critical hits for Battlesuits with larger arms like Berserker.
[*] Critical hit multipliers are now revamped for all weapons.
[*] By default, the multiplier for body shots and headshots is now x2 and x3 respectively. This was x3 and x5.
[*] Assault rifles ( XM13 and SiGAR ) body shots and headshots are now x2 and x3.5.
[*] Shotgun body shots and headshots are now x2 and x2. 
[*] Light machine body shots and headshots are now x1.5 and x2.
[*] In line with these new changes. We recognize that the damage is more consistent but dropped lower. Therefore, all bullet base weapons damage values have now been re-adjusted, matching them closer to the old time-to-kill.
[/list]

[h2]General Weapon Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added heavy weapon movement penalty to all equipment 
[*] ISW and Warthog clip size reduce to 120 from 150
[*] ISW starting clip reduced to 4 from 6.
[*] Warthog starting clip reduced to 4 from 5.
[*] Warthog firing speed increase to 11.1 shots per second ( up from 10 )
[*] AXR XM13 SpecOps , recoil adjusted, time between burst reduce to 0.24 ( down from 0.3 )
[*] All LMG package critical damage reduced to 20% (down from 50%). This means it deals 120% on bodyshot, and 140% on headshots. However, universally they all receive slightly increased base damage. Warthog increased to 115( from 92 ), ISW increased to 100( from 84 ).
[*] All LMG packages now have slightly increased spread on hipfire. 
[*] Changed Bio Injector healing behavior to heal over time instead of instant
[*] Increased GSF Bio Injector usage from 6 to 9
[*] XM13 spec ops shooting behavior returned
[*] XM13 specs ops now has 24 shots /clip with max ammo of 192 ( 8 clips ) 
[*] GSF Marksman increased damage to 120 from 70, firing rate change to 1.8 rounds per second , down from 4.54
[*] ZC9 hand cannon range increased to 70m from 50m 
[*] Increased credit cost of AXR EMP Grenade to 900 from 500
[*] Re-aligned G12 Sights
[*] Updated Lingering Fire visual and sound effects
[*] G12 Max Ammo has been reduced to 5 from 6
[*] M12 Bullshark Shotgun range increased to 60m from 50m.
[*] MASER will now show the damage per shot indicator when start shooting
[*] MRPG Cluster package max ammo is increased from 16 to 20
[/list]
[h2]Shockwave reworked[/h2]
[list]
[*] AXR Shockwave has been fully reworked. The new weapon functions similar to a shotgun with a static spread. Damage depends on how much the centre of the screen overlaps with the target itself. 
[*] Shockwave Overcharge package maintains the behavior of going past walls, but the damage penalty per wall has been removed. 
[*] Shockwave price is reduced to 500 credits from 900 credits.
[/list]
[h2]Gauntlet CPC reworked[/h2]
[list]
[*] CPC can now be fired instantly to deal Explosive damage
[*] New charging system was added where the CPC will automatically charge while holding it.
[*] Players can fire a stronger shot that deals AOE EMP and Shocks robotics Infantry by consuming 25% of the charge bar. 
[*] Clip Size Has been increased to 12 from 4
[*] Max ammo has been increased to 48 from 24
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/1de104cab30adb1311455352f1df75df740b1529.gif[/img]
[h2]Battlesuit Balance changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Hyperion Maelstrom will now deal 2000 total damage to structures (80 per seconds/ total 25 seconds)
[*] Hyperion Maelstrom will now deal 10000 total damage to vehicles (400 per seconds/ total 25 seconds)
[*] Hyperion Bombardment targeting is now revamped. Holding right click while in Aerial Bombardment will now lock on to a target, even behind walls.
[*] Hyperion "Aerial Bombardment" will now show all nearby targets when toggling this ability
[*] Hyperion’s passive ability has been changed. When active abilities are not on cooldown, the user acts as an APS, shooting down projectiles but only from the front.
[*] Siege Vanguard can now deploy 3 sentry guns instead of 2
[*] Optimized Assault Vanguard CAMG Airburst targeting algorithm. They will fire more accurately to maximize damage.
[/list]
[h2]Tutorial Changes and Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] Shooting range segment will now proceed automatically instead of manually clicking the terminal during each segment.
[*] Added a new segment in the tutorial range to teach players how to buy and upgrade weapons from Mules and Armory
[*] Players will now be given a completion prompt after “Completing Mission Objective Training” that redirects them to an option of their choice that could either be Return to the main menu to start a game, continue to RTS tutorial videos or continue challenge dome training.
[*] New sandbox section has been added to the tutorial range. Allowing players to spawn enemy units,vehicles and structures by using the terminal and giving players infinite credits to practice with any weapon. 
[/list]
[h2]New Seasonal Medals[/h2]
Medals are seasonal objective based cosmetic items that players can obtain by doing specific challenges. New Medals will be available during every season. Players can then set up their medals in the customization section and it will be shown in the main menu, Setup Lobby and the enemy death cam. Medals will have 3 different levels going from Bronze > Silver > Gold for each medal. Obtained medals will be in your account permanently even after the season is over. 

[h2]New Daily and Weekly Contracts[/h2]
Contracts have been added to Eximius!. These are challenges that reward players with credits when completed. Contracts are divided into Daily Contracts and Weekly Contracts. A total of 3 Daily contracts that refreshes in 24 hours and 1 Weekly contract which is a longer and more challenging contract will be available to players.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/4134276d22f8edd0a2b64f062d6e283aa30df72a.jpg[/img]
Contracts will reward players based on the difficulty of the task given. Daily contracts will always have an easy, medium and hard contract while weekly will have a much more difficult contract. Contracts are only available on online matches and will not be recorded if it's an offline match. 

[h2]UI/UX and Visual Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Silhouette highlighting is now reworked. 
[*] Enemy no longer has silhouette highlighting.
[*] UI: Contextual Ping change color to yellow
[*] Commander ability now shows the cooldown time remaining in numbers.
[*] Main menu: Added brighter reflection sphere for visor area
[*] Added icon for Burn effect
[*] Improved Sigma Charge shot shockwave trail VFX
[*] Passive Icon update for Hyperion
[*] Improved Sigma Ocular VFX
[*] Added GSF Lancer, M33 and M34 cannon barrel recoil effect
[*] Added GSF Lancer shell eject particle when Fired
[*] Added Phalanx Crew MG and AT cannon firing animation
[*] Modified effect for Maelstorm to be more see-thru
[*] Added New RTS cursor
[*] Minor adjustment to Ocular Defense muzzle VFX
[*] Added New Twilight and Clear Noon Lighting to all PVP Maps
[/list]

[h2]Improvement & Quality-of-life changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Ironguard now has proper animation when it's moving faster. 
[*] Ironguard Knight now sprints when out of combat or not shooting, moving at 6m/second. 
[*] Strategic map (M-key map) is now much brighter and has more contrast. Allowing you to see the details of the map.
[*] Improved movement behavior and physics for all AXR structure transports, they are much less likely to get stuck while deploying outside of base.
[*] AI Cannot see new units behind the Soft Cover but can track targets that are already visible. 
[*] AI now fires inaccurately when firing at units in softcover instead of not sighting them at all.
[*] Bullet firing infantry now prioritize infantry on attack
[*] Added Continue to next game function after the game has ended in the post game screen.
[*] Open Game Now Accepts Preferred Faction Type Upon Joining
[*] Improved AXR Battlesuit suit up animation.
[*] Changed Phantom Drone stealth radius draw is now using base tint black color and not the scanning texture.
[*] Drag Select will now select a Structure if nothing else is in the selection box
[*] Single Selection is now optimized for fast APM players
[*] Proximity mine and resupply crates will now display health when pointing at them
[*] Proximity mine and resupply crates will now show its icon in RTS view
[*] Friendly resupply crate will now show on strategic map
[*] Deployed Power reactor will now auto lock a nearby resource point when the resource point is [*] recaptured. Instead of undeploying and deploying again to lock the resource point. 
[*] Every infantry will now perform an avoid animation when be targeted or being shot at by Officer
[*] New SFX for CPC and ATR
[*] Added SFX for CPC charging related
[*] Added SFX when purchasing weapons from the armory
[*] Adjust SFX for Sigar Spec ops
[*] New SFX for Phalanx mounted machine gun
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/7f6ddb89ee989b7c944f2fad114b3605d828333a.gif[/img]

[h2]10 New Cosmetic Packs[/h2]
[h3]Axeron Industries [/h3]
[list]
[*] Frontline Jesters
[*] Galaxy Runners
[*] Terannean Guardians
[*] Twilight Wolves
[*] The Sky People
[/list]
[h3]Global Security Force[/h3]
[list]
[*] 279th Regiment
[*] Coastal Warriors
[*] Divine Armaments
[*] Dominators
[*] Fists Of Steel 
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/63c049009c6dd065171be4f8994bb574a4cf68d7.jpg[/img]

[h2]New Victory Poses[/h2]
Post game Victory poses have been added to the game giving players more customization options. Additional Victory poses can be bought from the store with in-game currency and owned Posses can be selected and equipped from the customization menu.

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Exploit neutralize point on mule lockdown will cause capture point permanently not able to be recapture

notes.title: Season 2 'Nemesis' - 2 Days
notes.notes:
[h2]Faction Change & Improvement[/h2]
One of the core focus of Season 2 is about making all units, technology and division relevant. We took a look at some of the overused and underused unit and gave it a fresh change.
Much of these changes involve adding and enhancing abilities of unit. We wanted to balance the choice of the game by adding to the weak instead of taking from the strong. 

Let's take a look at the changes.

Here are some of the it : 

[h3]Elite Marine Equipment[/h3]
In season 2, we're revamping the randomized equipment of Elite Marine. Giving more control to GSF commanders, the weapon choice is now an upgrade choice.  Elite marines will now start with the light machinegun but will have the choice to replace it's weapon to ATR or Grenade Launcher.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/54994ed64498db63cb96ed5537ba6e780602c78c.gif[/img]

[h3]Iron Guard Knight[/h3]
Next we take a look at the Knight variant of the IronGuard. In season 2, they now have improved speed and can sprint when not in combat. Additionally , the protocol upgrades have been merged for Rooks and Knights and do not require a separate upgrade. This means upon unlocking Robotics computing unit, the knight variant is immediately available.

Laser knights on the other hand receive a special Overload ability. This ability allow them to continuously fire their weapon without reloading at the cost of moderate damage over the duration of the overload.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/7f6ddb89ee989b7c944f2fad114b3605d828333a.gif[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/0675ba16fc7de9b0de73bd296eaa3bf97193f705.gif[/img]

[h3]Ocular Bombardment[/h3]
The Ocular Defense [i](Turret)[/i] now gain access to an upgrade, which allow the turret to fire light artillery at target location. This requires the Energy Division commander to be at tier 3.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/345becb1c37b90e56c46376ca195dc31b42dfa06.gif[/img]

[h3]Vehicle's Ability[/h3]
Most of the vehicle's ability has now been revamped. Sigma charged shot can now fire at obstacle and deal a heavy splash behind it. This shot is powerful enough to instantly kill marines and regular light infantry behind obstacles. One additional note here on Sigma is that, the regular weapon will now cut through APS. This is applicable to all type of railgun-type weapon, which affects Sigma and Guardian troopers.

Sigma Ocular's charged shot now summons a singularity charge at a target, exploding into a violent blast, damaging all types of units in a target area including structures and vehicles.

All GSF's vehicle now received reserved munition upgrade. IFV and APC has a temporary armor-piercing rounds. M34 Hellspawn has super napalm strike. MLRS will not automatically receive EMP warhead ability when reserved munition is upgraded. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/c0112e943a1acc359f6dd74eade047dbe00689fd.gif[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/52540a665a8b787e01d56307d5ddc5afa88cf711.gif[/img]

[h3]Recon Grenade[/h3]
Let's take a look at the Recon grenade. This grenade that is available to both faction will scan and mark unit in it's effective range until the grenade expires. It's a useful addition since players no longer highlight enemy silhouette behind walls.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/2926d130a70c5181e6cadcb922029ceba39ce205.gif[/img]

[h3]Starting Unit [/h3]
One significant change to early opening strategies is that, free units will now spawn at a starting barracks and fabricator the first time they are built. GSF Barracks receive 10 marines while fabricator receives 2 ironguard. This will reward players who go barracks first while punish greedy commanders that skip barracks to focus entirely on economy.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/f315a410893a13738e9040d8194fe51d86f4d539.gif[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/19fc0f3331f04f0cece29e2dd45f6f8355925ab0.gif[/img]

These are only a handful of improvement and changes coming in Season 2 'Nemesis'. Catch the full changelog when the update is launched.

Discuss with fellow officers on how you'd use this changes to it's full potential at our Official Community
[url=https://discord.gg/ammoboxstudios style=button] AmmoboxStudios discord[/url]

notes.title: Season 2 'Nemesis' - 3 Days
notes.notes:
[h2]Quality of Life Improvement[/h2]

With new weapon packages available for on ground officers, here's Quality of Life improvement that would hugely benefit everyone. below are handful of improvements made.

[h3]Unit Action Indicator[/h3]
Starting it off, unit command will now be singled out when group of units are selected, with the action unit being shown.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/3ee9f65937e881613fd5bf6651c6ba567d4f7385.gif[/img]

[h3]Seamless Movement Order[/h3]
Issuing movement orders to units will now transition seamlessly, without the unit stuttering and pausing before executing the latest move order.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/922945c2b13ecfb19c238db831690e0f53c8dbf9.gif[/img]

[h3]Unit Range Indicator[/h3]
When a Unit is selected, commander may hover over their weapon Icon [i](located in unit info)[/i] to check the unit's effective range. For unit with cone of attack, selecting the unit will automatically show it's attack cone, vehicle now have the "Face Direction" command to turn it in the needed direction.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/b5ee4cb3bac54f32e88fabd9eed088c610aecb40.gif[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/49f18d2650f49017958b612789d5c481d4fbbef8.gif[/img]

[h3]Mine Sweeping[/h3]
As a way for commander to have a means of defense against mine drops, commander's scan ability will now reveal Mines in the area, along with it's health available. In conjunction with this addition, Engineer and Scout now come equipped with ability to clear mine in targeted area.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/e04e6948ffe0a022db8ce2381cba383809beea63.gif[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/3a30d16dc626c7af06086dda68dbf13413da4097.gif[/img]

[h3]Cursor Improvement[/h3]
The cursor in commander view have also been given minor improvement, when targeting out-of-bound area, the cursor will now change to indicate the area is off limit
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/134d8a9e440df41b4235987fa753825e14c71cbc.png[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/60c77cdca1b356fe93628c9675bcaf1805187179.png[/img]

[h3]Dynamic Recon Drone[/h3]
More specific for AXR faction, the recon drone's scan area has been reduced, BUT, commander may now change the location of the scan with the drone's ability now.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/98f44772382d191fbe924a9e44f49c8564d35601.gif[/img]

[h3]Explosion Splash Damage[/h3]
On more combat specific improvement, small arm explosion [i](i.e: grenades)[/i] will no longer deal splash damage through wall/obstacles
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/5235653098121a857c56db266cf39bd4a28f51f1.gif[/img]

[h3]Hostile Unit Highlight[/h3]
A highly requested changes will be on unit/hostile highlight, enemies will no longer be fully highlighted, as opposed to previous where officers are able to observe detected hostile unit's movement even through walls
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/34daf4fd954f6a7c441e16c2a9772b654ae32b43.png[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/0216ce584c84c9a3ef6c4f9729252ced9a14c706.png[/img]
