notes.title: Eximius 1.0.9 Update - June 11th, 2021
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/7713008904d9358f9ce6fad62a837bb49cc89174.png[/img]
This update features a revamped Academy map, community suggested accessibility feature, balance changes and a number of reported bug fixes.


[h1]Academy Revamped[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/ebb6d16231dc158c1beabebda3992ddf0a1149d9.png[/img]
The symmetry of the map has been re-balance to provide a more fair gameplay for both sides. The most noticeable change is on the south side of the map which has more defensible areas as well as re-positioning the south base slightly up north. New credit points are also added for both sides near to the dead zones of the map and all major resource points are remeasured to ensure they are closer by at least a 5% margin.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/3d95e3dd4779b69fe1373d7dd813b006edd97d12.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/47f442605f293e31d2beab131116150cbb8e54c9.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/533929a6bdbf563e5085e1acc245601ef70fca40.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/9792ff9f0a604250ff60b7980a984eb7e3713e91.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/c8989ac0f2a76bba7d6db006cf7347666d7f57f8.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/c59e3247946877f3a988b5c4d2d412e7e6456864.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/c0371513f6ef083f12a366d052076566dd19049d.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/3c43eece60ffa5a3f89fd278722c5a62c6b4eba7.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/b0dd58156919e482ea4db4a20bd81eb160f2d8f2.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/e0ff1400c601b8fd0760b3d4dba491b4fb54f71d.png[/img][/url]


[h1]Gameplay Improvements[/h1]
This update includes 3 major Gameplay improvements.

[h3]Self Destructible Battlesuit Pods[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/a44c5872c49865eba8da3f02c65630e2325f53e5.gif[/img]
Battlesuit Pods can new be self destructed by calling in a new pod. This helps players regain their battlesuit if they lost or miss placed them with the cost of re-buying a battlesuit. 

[h3]Hand Grenades[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/bd236749c048c3d0af418a8b54ab96f447e5ffc9.gif[/img]
Throwing a hand grenade while running will now increase its travel distance. We have also tuned the hand grenade to be more accurate by reducing its throwing arc and cook timer while increasing its projectile speed to land in the estimated area quicker.

[h3]Templar Revival Changes[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/cfa8a419f3eb1ce830365765498d376dc1535565.gif[/img]
Templar will now auto repair itself when in DBNO and will revive based on their amount of health instead of time. Templars will start repairing itself upon not taking any damage for 2 seconds.


[h1]UI/UX Improvements[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/1326c94fcaf011edc686852a707fe0c0554c9831.jpg[/img]
2 main quality of life UI/UX improvements has been added to the game.

[h3]Controller Accessibility[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/c1008dae942c630d029878a41730c8fe8e70ada4.png[/img]
As requested by the community, we have added new accessibility feature for the controller players out there that gives you the option to adjust your Vertical, Horizontal and ADS sensitivity. Although Eximius does not fully support controllers yet, dedicated players from our community has created guides to help out players that prefer to play with controllers. 

If you are interested to play Eximius with a controller, check out this guide made by EXO70694 and as we further develop Eximius we will provide more support for the controller as well.
[h3][b][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2503891348]Eximius Controller Guide[/url][/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/cb1efd0fc0e620b042141735895bc57c86d7b11d.png[/img]

[h3]Main Menu Adjustments[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/6207235b49ea02ac32b30d25282400aec2d2f2d1.png[/img]
Some changes was also made in the main menu. The main menu has been reshuffled to help players navigate it much more easier. The online match button is now much more bigger and moved to the front. Pressing the online match button will now directly bring players to the server browser where they can select a lobby to play in.

Release Notes for 11th June 2021
[h1]1.0.9 Changelog[/h1]

[b]Gameplay[/b]
- Players can now self destruct their previous lost or missplaced Battlesuit POD by calling in a new Battlesuit.
- AI officer will now self-destruct existing pod when re-spawning.
- Throwing a grenade while running will now increases its travel distance. 

[b]Level[/b]
- Academy PVP Map Revamped

[b]Balance Changes[/b]
- All Grenades Throw Speed is increased to 2100 from 1800
- All Grenades Arch is Lowered to 24' from 35'
- All Grenades Cook Timer Decreased to 3.5 from 5
- Templar's revive is now based on health instead of time.
- Templar's will start repairing itself upon not taking any damage for 2 seconds. 
- Exploit Vanguard "Scarab Swarm" will no longer apply blind buff
- Exploit Vanguard "Scarab Swarm" now gives 30% extra damage instead of 100%
- Assault Vanguard "Airburst" locking time is decreased to 0.2 seconds from 0.75 seconds
- Berserker's shockwave now also deal regular AOE damage and knockdown when punching a direct target
- Berserker's "Shockpunch" damage to structures is decreased by 66%
- GSF Infantry General "Infantry Weapon Package" upgrade is now default
- GSF Infantry General "Marine Armor Pads" bullet reduction damage is increased to 33% from 15%
- Armory and Mule lock down range has been increased to 15 meters from 10 meters


[b]Challenge Changes[/b]
- "Mission Objective Training" will now start with 500 Weapon Credits
- "Mission Objective Training" enemy spawn interval has been increased after capturing the victory point
- "AEGIS Battlesuit Challenge" will now start with max Weapon Credits
- "AEGIS Battlesuit Challenge" Ironguards spawn delay is decreased to 1 second from 5 seconds
- Elite Marine spawns has been removed from AEGIS Battlesuit Challenge
- Unit call out sounds are now disabled in the Tutorial


[b]UI/UX[/b]
- Implemented Mouse ADS Sensitivity Multiplier
- Implemented Controller Horizontal Sensitivity, Vertical Sensitivity and ADS Sensitivity multiplier
- Updated Ace Vanguard Icon
- Updated Units and Structure icons in the Spectator HUD to a button style
- Fixed GSF Fortification "Defensive Counter Measure" Jammer ability text shows "Select Area to Scan" instead of "Select Area to Jam"
- Updated Main menu online match button artwork
- Updated Challenges UI in the Challenge Dome
- Updated minimap for Downtown


[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
- Fixed Echelon Weapon Crew APS deploy range is set incorrectly
- Fixed Echelon Weapon Crew when deploying ACM is showing APS icon instead
- Fixed an issue where the match timer includes the duration of the setup lobby
- Both spectator and player timer will now be based on the duration of the match
- Fixed Ocular defence misfiring when approached from an angle. Ocular Defence is now 100% accurate.
- Fixed an issue where GSF AI Commander will not lockdown points
- Fixed GSF AI Commander placing an Armory at Victory Points
- Fixed Mule Lockdown refunds credits when deployed
- Fixed an issue where the effects of flashbangs causes infantry units to slide. 
- Fixed Engineer constantly facing a stucture when a repair order is issued
- Fixed Assault Vanguard "Homing Missile" ability not auto firing if initially locked on to 6 targets

notes.title: Eximius 1.0.7 Update - May 12th, 2021
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/b46e2b0ef41d2e8672298aaf116fb3d5a65a0a1e.png[/img]

This major update features an exciting new content drop plus many community-driven ideas as well as major bug fixes that has been reported for some time.
We've finally released the revamped classic downtown, the first map to be featured in the Early Access is now completely revamped with new art assets and extended play area. 
Be sure to check it out. 

[h2][b]New PVP / Team Skirmish Map ( Downtown )[/b][/h2]
As we have teased previously, the very first map of Eximius during alpha/prototype phase is finally making a return, after an extensive major revamp.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/1b4674f7458140e8bcfb1b016fc066f5bb0870eb.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/1b4674f7458140e8bcfb1b016fc066f5bb0870eb.gif[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/b3787f7f0b7c921e92956a37ea996f2532d1f2c2.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/b3787f7f0b7c921e92956a37ea996f2532d1f2c2.gif[/img][/url]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/893bf90572011610574c2e54b17a0619d86be114.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/893bf90572011610574c2e54b17a0619d86be114.gif[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/8493bc99b73954b2ff5a320f7eda8d8d4cc4d8a8.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/8493bc99b73954b2ff5a320f7eda8d8d4cc4d8a8.gif[/img][/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/7c863b5f803e2211ba62dc5ccd56460599c917d0.png[/img]
Several areas and Victory Point locations in Express Victory underwent an overhaul. After the recent [url=https://www.twitch.tv/videos/1008706064]Zenzo Tournament[/url], we engaged with top level players and community members on some critical balance issue of this map, mostly being the Resource & Victory Points being favored to South team. Changing these locations also creates more dynamic play in certain part of the map and reducing dead zones. We've also added elevated defensible high ground for North side of the base as well. 

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/e12f3f4f088eeb0267a9beac55d7ddf022aaa498.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/067326a3bb7dae82f8e5978ce6ab07fe70b2db90.jpg[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/04a182afb809104332f182202ab2e873a0865652.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/e1f75a923b6136f193bc8bff41cd39213d25d4c9.jpg[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/e9913a6191b69e68e0b191cbdf28ffda0478421d.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/79f9913be02aa0f8f6dadc0f5c025b50a0dba7df.jpg[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/8954a9d09893c9aeb30fc900d8e1dd88d9c62950.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/b8b436752f9675c5823f4f1d0f08fa5b9f765a13.jpg[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/0dffcad51a0d320b0a73e422144d0173d8dd42e6.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/7e71f5b919e89349a63d8709f1209f0c4fd7eb41.jpg[/img][/url] 

[h2][b]UI/UX Improvements[/b][/h2]
Today's update also includes 3 major UI/UX improvements. 
[olist]
[*] Highly requested Toggle mode for sprint , crouch and aim down sight (ADS) has been implemented. This can be turned on/off in Settings->Controls
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/ac0b6221abd73af94f07e706320047df482a1123.png[/img]
[*] Armory improvements has been added. You can now drag/drop your Primary Weapons and swap their slots. This addresses a huge issue highlighted by the community that sometimes weapons slots will be swapped after getting into a Battlesuit.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/6d4af3d6b8b7d707e141e71016b61a393811c9f4.gif[/img]
[*] On the RTS side, to prevent button clutter, some Unit Commands will only appear when Units of the same group is selected. This helps the buttons to stay in a more predictable position.
[/olist]

[h2][b]Community Driven Fixes[/b][/h2]

On the area of fixes, we would like to highlight the Suggestion Bot that we've recently created to help us sort through the community's ideas. This bot will gather your suggestion and organize them in a discord bot, allowing developers to sift through and separate salty complains and constructive suggestions. But rest assured, they're all weighted similarly for considerations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/32732744b6ff236263a8bcd9adc34ad6573eb541.jpg[/img]
One example is a recent suggestion was to give the Officers the ability to have your Squad defend an area. This has been implemented through a Hunker-Down Squad Command. Using this Command allows you to get your Squad to temporary not follow you, while defending the area.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/9da6c795ffbb393349f52e81d89a89283fc32ac0.png[/img]

If you would like to be part of the discussion, everyone is welcomed. Remember to head on to our [url=http://discord.gg/ammoboxstudios]Discord[/url]

[h2][b]Minor Upgrades to AI Commander[/b][/h2]
We are continuously making improvements to the Commander AI. We noted some blind spots that made the AI performed in a less than ideal manner. Now, AXR AI Commanders will now lockdown resource points and GSF AI Commanders will now upgrade Power Plants when possible. Some improvements were also made in regards to the Build Order. Expect them to perform better. 

[h2][b]Balance Changes[/b][/h2]
3 Major balance changes are coming into play. 

[h3]Emergency Shield Pack[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/ae5c3ee9b99e47904c856efbe1425383e3b9d55f.gif[/img]
The most contentious equipment in the 'Zenzo Eternal' tournament has been bought to highlight. While we want to maintain a special position of this equipment, the Emergency Shield Pack (ESP) has been deemed too valuable even with the increased cost. 

Adjustment has been made after some discussion with community. With this new update, the ESP has been tuned to half the use duration and most importantly, at the end of use, the user will be without a shield for 5 seconds. This effectively means that ESP can only be used at the edge of the frontline where you're 3-4 seconds away from a safe friendly area. If you over-extend, you will still be punished if an enemy chases you down while your ESP is on. After this change, we will continue to assess to see if the ESP remains in good position.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/4a26b55fcc1e5f2e370973806c14c49e8063904f.gif[/img]

[h3]IronGuard Knight[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/4ab6b544fac10386c9b454bf81d7a28d7fdfe0e7.gif[/img]
Knight Ironguard is going through an improvement as well. As per discussion with community, it is deemed that Knight is still in a less than ideal position as a Tier 3 infantry. In this update, we decided to give it a stronger anti-armor role. When targeting enemy Vehicles/Structures, Knight will fire a single powerful Anti-Armor shot. This secondary shot is automatically used without any additional actions needed. 

[i]Take note that despite this, Laser Knight is still significantly better in dealing with enemy Armor[/i]

[h3]Scout vs Marines[/h3]
This has been a longstanding issue of whether Scouts are better than Marines in many situations. Despite having more HP and higher DPS, marines has constantly been defeated by the same number of scouts. We have found that the issue is in the engagement range. Having the advantage of firing first means the Scout can often flinch the Marine before their weapon can be drawn. This causes a further delay before Marines can return fire.
We have now increased the Marines engagement range to be similar to Scouts. However, despite this Scouts may still have a slight advantage at longer distance due to better weapon spread.

[h3] Ace Vanguard changes [/h3]
Another longstanding issue since launch. Many players have used Ace Vanguard Eagle Strike to illegally access many supposedly inaccessible areas. This has caused many issues like collision glitches, exiting the map and creating other unfair advantages. We tried blocking access to those areas, but it ended up being too much work and we couldn't beat the 'creative' power of gamers.  

In this update, Ace Vanguard Eagle Striking into an illegal area will perform a return flight to the original location. Apart from this, nothing else will change. Illegal areas are defined as areas that cannot be accessed by a regular infantry.

notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/accb44ac84e99ac9bd9640e0584f44ed20e7ca79.jpg[/img]

Hello Officers,

Here's the first update for the 1.0 version of the game! You can find multiple balance changes, UI/UX improvements and bugs and crash fixes. Thanks for sending us the suggestions and the crash reports as they help us to take the necessary steps to improve the overall 'Eximius' experience. Some suggestions might take more time to implement due to the complexity or priority.

Next, we'll be working on adding more content and improvement to the games. We'll in the final stages of preparing the localisation. For the 1st round, we'll be supporting Russian, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese and German. We're looking into supporting other languages if we see that there's a demand for it.

Many credits to the community who reported, assisted and discussed the issues with us. 

Release Notes for 25th March 2021

[h1]1.0.1 Changelog[/h1]

[b]Gameplay Changes[/b]
- Support Crawler will now resupply weapons
- Templar can now be blinded by Flashbangs
- Phantom/Recon Drones are now limited to 3 at a single time. Deployment now cost 1,200 Credits and 600 Supplies
- Priority Attack will no longer interrupt Latent Commands
- Sigma Tank will no longer lose charged shot after being issued a Priority Attack Command
- Vehicles will now try to avoid Weapon Crew but may still run them down when there's no other available path
- Adjusted hitboxes for Assault Vanguard, Siege Vanguard, Ace Vanguard and Berserker
- Removed Reserve Munition Upgrade from Infantry Division due to no applicable units
- Removed Crawler Cargo Improvement from Robotics Division due to no applicable units
- Removed Enhance Combat Training Upgrade for GSF. Players can now resupply their Ammo from Field Supports by interacting with them
- Updated shortcut keys for multiple Unit Upgrades in AXR and GSF Research Structures as to not clash with Push to Talk Button (Y Key)
- Commander Centre Default Energy Resource production increased to 5 from 3
- GSF & AXR Turret upkeep energy reduced to 2 from 3

[b]Assault Vanguard Changes[/b]
- Smite (Passive Ability) no longer gives speed bonus
- Smite now flinch self for 1.3 seconds when hitting a player, up from 0.5 seconds. This gives players only 0.2 seconds bonus time to shoot after knocking down another player.

[b]Exploit Vanguard Changes[/b]
- Passive Ability radius recuded to 20M from 50M

[b]Ace Vanguard Changes[/b]
- Ace Vanguard Eagle Strike Knockdown time on enemy Officers is reduced to 1.5 seconds from 2.3 seconds

[b]Balance Changes[/b]
- Templar pop usage increased to 9 from 6
- Ironguard Core pop usage is dropped to 7 from 8
- Service Ironguard pop usage reduced to 7 from 12
- Omicron Sonic damage reduced to 150 from 600
- Omicron Sonic splash radius reduced to 550 from 750
- Bio Injector effects will no longer stack, instead it will refresh the duration
- GSF Shotgun spread is slightly tighter
- GSF Shotgun damage reduced to 45 from 55 per pellet
- GSF Shotgun range cap increased to 50M from 40M
- GSF Shotgun Incendiary range increased to 30M from 28M
- AXR XM13 Spec-Ops cooldown between burst dropped to 0.3 from 0.4

[b]Level Changes[/b]
- Fixed players not being able to complete "EMP the Tank" Achievement when using Gauntlet CPC on Enemy Tank
- Fixed Enemy Tank sometimes not being able to reach destination
- Patched a hole in Crossing
- Starting Weapon Credits are increased to 2,500 from 2,000 in Tank Challenge
- Improved Grunt AI accessibiility at Strip Mall area in Crossing

[b]Keybinding [/b]
- Improved Keybinding and Handling of Duplicated Key
- Removed duplicated binded keys
- Fixed Assigning Axis-based keys such as Movement (E.g Move Forward) causing one of the Axis Scale to not Function 
- Fixed Right Mouse Button and Ctrl keys not being abled to be binded successfully due to keys being used for debugging functions

[b]UI/UX[/b]
- "Our Forefathers..." no longer plays at startup, instead will only play one time after loading the Main Menu. 
- Added option to skip the Cinematic Intro as well. Players can rewatch by clicking on Play Intro at the Main Menu Side Option.
- Added Waiting Screen for Spectators while waiting for teams to start the game
- Added Difficulty Indicator in Spectator Scoreboard for Team Skirmish and PVE 
- Added Spectator Waiting in Lobby Screen
- Style update for Main Menu and Server Selection Pop Up
- Updated in-game Quick Guide. Can be accessed in-game by pressing Esc key and clicking on Help-Tips
- Updated Elite Marine RTS Icon
- Players can now choose Officer and immediately move to the next stage of the Setup Lobby in Offline Team Skirmish. Previously, players will need to either choose Commander or wait for the timer to tick down.
- Players can now use the 'ESC' key to close the Battlesuit Selection Screen, Scoreboard and Armory/MULE Menu 

[b]Custom Lobby[/b]
- Upon entering the Custom Lobby, Players are automatically moved and Auto Balanced into teams slots

- Added Steam Chat Filtering into Custom Lobby and in-game. Players can set their preferences on their Steam Community Content Preference. Please read this for more information. https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/593110/view/2855803154584367415

Hello Officers,

We hope that you had a great time with Eximius so far. We been monitoring the game over the last few hours and we identified a few issues that we plan to fix as soon as possible.

Day 1 Known Issues
[olist]
[*]Crashes related to Tutorial and Challenges
[*]Matchmaking
[*]Unfinalised Localisation
[/olist]
[h3][u]Crashes related to Tutorial and Challenges[/u][/h3]
This issue is top on our to-fix priority. We received multiple reports from players saying that they are encountering crashes when they enter the Challenge Dome or when they complete a challenge. This issue is more complicated than what we expected and we'll be contacting Epic Games (we are using Unreal Engine) directly to figure out a fix.

[h3][u]Matchmaking[/u][/h3]
Currently, the match up between players is less than ideal. While many games were created, most of them were from Custom Games. We decided to take down matchmaking to adjust the matchmaking algorithm. For now, please create games through Custom Games or join ongoing matches with the Server Browser.

[h3][u]Unfinalised Localisation[/u][/h3]
Players with RU, CN, and DE locale may notice that their game is partially translated to their language. This is an unintentional localisation addition. The translations are still being finalised and pending review so they do not reflect the final quality that we intended. For players who would like to switch back to English, please follow the guide below. At the Culture setting simply change from ru to en.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/8a4b29d49ef4bec2f70040312bf4afb0322aeda6.png[/img]

Once we have a solid fix for the crashes, we intend to roll it out as soon as possible. 
You will soon receive a hotfix that addresses the unfinished localisation, matchmaking changes and a possible fix to stop the game from running in VR Mode for players using VR Kits.

You can contact the dev team at: [url=discord.gg/ammoboxstudios]Ammobox Studios[/url].
We thank you for your patience.

Signing Out

notes.title: [ Final ] Launch Countdown + Customizations
notes.notes:
We're few hours away from 1.0 Launch.

In this round of showcase, we will be presenting the customization and cosmetic system that is newly implemented. This will serve as part of player progressions. Unlock skin packs with in-game currency and level them up when playing and completing online matches. As you level up the pack tiers, more cosmetic items will be available such as callsigns, banner, and frames. The skin itself will also increase in complexity. You can also buy your way through these tiers with in-game currency.

[previewyoutube=Z8-UcXwbzJ4;full][/previewyoutube]

These are some notes on how the cosmetic items work :
[list]
[b] [*] Skin packs :[/b]  Individual cosmetic pack , unique to each faction. Can only be unlocked with in-game currency. After unlocking, it can be upgraded up to 8 times. Each upgrade will provide an additional item. Skin packs can be upgraded as you win matches with the equipped skin or by fast-leveling them with in-game currency known as 'Credits'
[b] [*] Credits :[/b]  Credits can be earned when you level your rank. It is used to purchase new skin packs and to fast-level them. 
[b] [*] Player Skins:[/b]  These replaces the texture material on the character, each pack contain up to 3 tier. At the highest tier, your assigned squad members will also receive the skins, allowing you to have a full squad with the skin. 
[b] [*] Player Frames :[/b]  These are the frames that display your callsign in-game. Like the skins, they also have tiers that can be unlocked.
[b] [*] Team Banners :[/b]  These are commander selected only cosmetic. By choosing a banner, your base and surrounding areas will be decorated with these banner. Show the enemy who is in town.
[b] [*] Callsigns  :[/b]  Your player character will be identified as these callsigns in-game. They are unique to per-faction and is one of the item unlocked in the skin packs. These callsign will also have an individual representation on the minimap.  Unlike the Early Access version, callsigns can now have customized frames , hence you can mix and match them.
[b] [*]  Rank :[/b]  Represent your rank this season. As you play more matches, you will rank up. Each game earns you experience(XP). Victory gives you higher XP than loses. As you rank up, you gain Credit. Rank will be reset each season but not your stats.

notes.title: Eximius 1.0 Full Release Content Summary
notes.notes:
[b]The countdown Begins[/b]

For the next 7 days until the launch, we will be publishing one content video a day for each of the item below. In the meantime here's the summary on what's coming.

Let us know in the comment below what you think and what you're looking forward to play.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/16b28268ab444b3a0663c245aeca48ad0ea270e6.jpg[/img]

[h1]Battlesuits[/h1]
Battlesuits are powerful suits that can be called down by players at the cost of weapon credits. Wearing these suits will grant players abilities that can change the tides of battle. We increased the amount of Battlesuits from 4 to 8 for the 1.0 launch. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/f8c0304d4035fe959a0e6ad874e76bc30c415526.jpg[/img]
[i]Battlesuit Lineup[/i]

On top of that, these Battlesuits now have Passive abilities in addition of their 2 Active ones. The Passive abilities will compliment the roles of the Battlesuit further while making each and every one more unique to play.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/3883129dbdc3b30b7bc79f0fecf619a27e76ce55.png[/img]
[i]Passive Abilities[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/40584395193fc3ea07f61bde7d399d730225cd0b.gif[/img]
[i]Orion's Sleight of Feet in action[/i]

[h1]Faction Divisions & New Units[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/51822d85a0c98b2c893e7c61dedbe59ad840da06.jpg[/img]
[i]The 6 Faction Divisions of Eximius[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/463b02202e7b4d42a38668e14a628a7352dca5ae.png[/img]
[i]New Unit Lineups [/i]

This is a big one. The entire unit roster of Eximius has been more than doubled now. With the introduction of this new feature, Each faction will be sub-divided into 3 division. 

These divisions have different capabilities; ranging from new units, new technologies to new Commander Abilities. Each offering a different playstyle of your choice. Faction division can be selected during the setup lobby.

We don't want to get too much into detail since this itself will take an entire post. There will be a follow-up video during one of the countdown. Stay tuned to catch the details of the new units, abilities and upgrades.


[h1]DBNO[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/79b71a35b6347da2f495c4427893caf047d5e823.jpg[/img]

The 'Down But Not Out' (DBNO) mechanic make its way into Eximius. When you're defeated by a player, your teammates has a limited amount of time to bring you back into the battle. 


[h1]Asset Remaster & New Units Voicelines[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/749a6f85e68b75b810d08bc74c05e4111203b20d.jpg[/img]
[i]Old GSF Units and New GSF Units Lineup[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/ac4523c2bbf9513201e382b207ea9583a0625073.jpg[/img]
[i]Old and New SIGAR[/i]

For those in Early Access, you would recognize the GSF units on the left. Those models were used since our prototype and they have served their purpose as a placeholder. We remastered them along with many of the older assets in Eximius such as buildings and weapons. 

New voice lines are added for all units for both RTS and FPS as well. On the FPS side, units can play different voice cues depending on the context such as "Under Attack" or "Enemy Spotted". Keep an ear out and take advantage of the situation.


[h1]New Maps[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/0d89b427c9679ab3ed7b6f70436f03eeaec3b10b.png[/img]
[i]Sunday Mall[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/5d4b919fc5a5ea32b9b6110c8c209108a6e2c2e8.jpg[/img]
[i]Precious Cargo[/i]

Two new maps will be added

First is Sunday Mall, a PVP map centered around large open space of carpark and mall. Get your shopping gear ready as we raid the frontline.

The second one is Precious Cargo, an escort PVE mission. Players will need to protect a moving cargo from enemy raiders and bombers. 

[h1] Environment Remastering [/h1]
On top of having new maps. All the current PVP / PVE map has gone through remastering. Lighting, shading , foliage and assets has been remastered and optimized. Below are some examples
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/503a8cf8b57016faf290da75647f7b0339ee3b2a.png[/img]
[i]Central[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/476b9af6a55f10b614bfae458f091576980bdd97.jpg[/img]
[i]Academy[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/a00a5424754408b4895d6e23b7f3f2685cdf0711.jpg[/img]
[i]Express[/i]

[h1]New Techtree[/h1]

On the Commander side, the entire Techtree has gone through an overhaul. Previously we didn't have a proper tiering system, resulting in all technology unlock being lumped into one or two tech building. With this new system, as you tech up, the tiers are much more distinct.  Each faction will start from Tier 1, and will advance to Tier 2 and then finally in Tier 3, commander will choose to commit their resources into one of the 3 possible Tier 3 branch. This will be applicable to both factions. The picture above shows the three possible branching tech at tier 3. 

Take an example of GSF. After having Armored Logistics in Tier 2, you can choose to upgrade one of the three possible structure into a Tier 3 tech building.

Advanced Barracks - Unlocks Elite Marine & other upgrades
Advanced Armored Logistics - Unlocks Cyclone HWS & other upgrades
Advanced Supply Centre - Unlocks Guardian trooper & other upgrades

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/203b7e4a0a103605ae475afb46c377cd74b17e60.jpg[/img]
[i]GSF New Upgradable Buildings[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/04f61001415713aebbf904e90ecc3f9aaebf9c97.jpg[/img]
[i]AXR New Upgradable Buildings[/i]

[h1]Reinforcement System[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/09a53b2b68e47a654d966915e0b19047165316d1.jpg[/img]
[i]Reinforcement Tier 2[/i]

A new reinforcement system is introduced for Eximius 1.0. We intend for it to work primarily as an underdog mechanic by giving the losing team a small boost of units. The reinforcement will activate when a team Victory Points drop below a certain threshold. Each team will have 3 charges of Reinforcement. Use this to your advantage!

[h1]Customisation, Cosmetics & Progression[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/a17d4604d679a3f9498e8c3f23e20c9dc84b6d33.jpg[/img]
[i]Store Page[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/c4c7f3fc3346a7b3d143f33a6f455aab84144116.png[/img]
[i]Players can personalise their Player Cards by mix and matching their frames and emblems
[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/02639bb3fd4924dbced71269fa30bca6bc62b03b.jpg[/img]
[i]Costume Battle Pass System. Players can equip and level up their obtained cosmetic pack[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/00bd2f59bdf072d8f57991483040e11d559cac29.jpg[/img]
[i]At Level 6, attached Squad Units will receive cosmetics as well.[/i]

The customization system has finally been unlocked. A high demand feature that we have been working on for some time. Players can now purchase skin packs from in-game store and level them up. As they level up, more cosmetic options will be unlocked similar to a Battle Pass.  There will be no lootbox or pay-to-win mechanics.

[h1] Complete UI Revamp [/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/e78ac08024b3cae2ec73c1e064f55657ebf3be99.jpg[/img]

Every single major part of the UI has been revamped. Starting from the main menu all the way the FPS and RTS HUD screens. This is something you definitely won't miss when logging into the game. 


We'll be dropping more additional updates on our social media over the next week leading up to the launch day. Remember to wishlist, & share if you have not.  Community is at discord.gg/ammoboxstudios

Once again, we await you at the frontline.
Signing out.

Officers!

We hoped you enjoyed the announcement trailer above. 
After 2 years of being in early access, we are proud and excited to move Eximius out of Early Access.

Throughout our development, we always wanted to make an awesome strategic shooter, blending the best experiences of FPS and RTS. With Eximius, we think that we managed to craft a unique and fun experience and we can't wait to share them with you thanks to the big participation from our players. Many features , innovation and changes were the result of our discussions with our community at Discord ( discord.gg/ammoboxstudios ).

We cannot emphasize enough on how big of a change v1.0 will be and we're excited to reveal this over the next several weeks. In short :

[list]
[*]A big chunk of the gameplay code was rebuilt from ground-up from scratch.
[*]There is more than double the available of new units and battlesuits.
[*]Massive change to the Tiering system in RTS and a range whole new technology and ability for players.
[*]Significant portion of Art Assets are remastered into much higher quality. For example, every single GSF Infantry unit now have a new look.
[*]The entire network backend was rewritten from the ground up. Featuring customisation, progression unlock and an in-game store were some of the resulting changes.
[/list]

These are some of the things that we will reveal further over the next few weeks leading up to the launch date. So keep an eye out on our Social Media and Steam page.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/58027a816b53e4934ec4c9940100c349cd9eea90.png[/img]

Hello Officers,

Ammobox Studios is committed to making Eximius the best game it can be. Throughout our Early Access period, we've strived to create an engaging and fun experience for both new and established players as we build towards our 1.0 release in Q1 2021.

As part of our commitment, the team has decided to temporarily remove Eximius from sale on Steam Early Access as we push toward the full game’s launch.

To our dedicated community: Don't worry! You'll still be able to play Eximius, and we're not going anywhere! Our servers will stay online and they’ll continue to operate as normal. This simply means starting 10th of September 2020, the game will no longer be available for new players to purchase until we release version 1.0 early next year. 

This move will allow us to concentrate and focus all of our energy on the final months of development. 

We're a small studio making a big game, and we can't wait to show you everything we're creating. If you'd like to get a sneak peek of what's coming with our 1.0 launch, follow us on social media and tune into our bi-weekly podcast for in-depth looks at upcoming content!

notes.title: Eximius Update - June 22nd, 2020
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/2a402784540898d38e66e5c16926025182eaf6b9.jpg[/img]

Hello Officers,

We're releasing a balance update. After our previous [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/505740/partnerevents/edit/2386292744374188734]tournament (more info here)[/url] we reviewed all the games and thought that the Commanders and Officers are having a bit of leeway when it comes to Commander Ability. We decided to have some of the Commander Abilities to affect allies as well, damage and buff effects included. It's quite a big change so we'll be monitoring to see if it needs further tweaking or not.

We also did some minor changes on the weapons as well. The light machine guns was the most used guns throughout the tournament due to it's low recoil. This made the LMG a very deadly and efficient weapon, perhaps a bit too deadly. We tweaked the shooting behavior slightly as a response to that.

The AXR Orion and GSF Exploit Vanguard gets a nerf and buff respectively, something our community has been requesting for awhile now. You can read more regarding the changes below.

Also, [url=https://bitsummit.org/en]Bitsummit Gaiden[/url] is happening this weekend. Be sure to check out our games and many other wonderful indie titles. ːsteamhappyː

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/a70e6b9d94f4a182feba3638d0e24ba4c316fd9d.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/57f79f3dcea8ccfc458ee6638081f053576cf0be.jpg[/img]


Release Notes for 22nd June 2020

[h1]0.56.5 Changelog[/h1]

[b][Gameplay Changes][/b]
- Following Commander's Ability will now deal friendly fire
- Artillery Strike (& Improved Ordnance Airburst)
- Targeted Strike (& Tactical Strike)
- EMP Strike (EMP will now affect both allies and enemies)

[b][Level Changes][/b]
- Downtown 
- Aesthetic cleanup (floating & missing objects)
- Fixed Bank near Team 1 having no collision
- Added extended walls on both Team 0 and Team 1 base to prevent base to base attack

[b][Balance Changes][/b]
- AXR Scout movement speed decreased from 600 to 550
- AXR XM13 equip speed is slightly increased to match up to GSF SIGAR
- GSF & AXR light machine gun have higher initial recoil. The recoil lowers when it's fired over a longer period of time
- GSF SIGAR Default and Assault package Spread are slightly reduced
- AXR Orion Shock Trap cooldown is increased from 7.5 seconds to 8.5 seconds
- AXR Orion Shock Trap 'Shocked' buff duration is decreased from 15 seconds to 12 seconds
- AXR Aegis Exo-Shield cooldown (on break) is increased from 20 seconds to 30 seconds
- GSF Exploit Vanguard Hacking speed and Effect duration is increased significantly for most hack-types 
- GSF Exploit Vanguard Hacking cooldown is increased from 15 seconds to 22 seconds
- GSF Exploit Vanguard Scarab Swarm cooldown is decreased from 75 seconds to 65 seconds

[b][Fixes][/b]
- Fixed AXR Scout having fast weapon equipping speed
- Fixed Challenge Mode not marking the first achievement as complete when challenge is attempted for the first time
- Fixed Chosen Faction in Tutorial and Challenge Mode being overridable
- Fixed AXR AI not being able to build on Team 1, Var 1 build location
- Fixed Grenade animation being interrupted when switching weapon
- Fixed EMP Shield Disabling not removing allied Shields
- Fixed rare crash when player with attached squad jumps into the water in Crossing

notes.title: Eximius Update - May 31st, 2020
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/baa52dbc3b26a5fdeaf0fc79fe6229d8b442434c.jpg[/img]
[h3]Game Update[/h3]

Hello Officers,

In this update, we added 'Intel' in the Main Menu. Intel will serve as a library for players new and old to learn more about the units, Battlesuits, structures, weapons and vehicles in Eximius. We plan to expand it with the upcoming new content. Do let us know what other stats you would like to see. We also did some minor tweaks to the AI, weapons and the Spectator Mode as well as the usual bug fixes. 

For our next major update we're toying with the idea of adding a DBNO mechanic. It should create a more interesting team dynamic and experience surrounding a downed teammate. We're curious to know what do you think about it? Let us know here or on our Discord channel.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/dba67afe49fff3a0c7f8241f07c69032f95094f9.jpg[/img]

[h3]Eximius Level-Up Play-One Invitational Tournament[/h3]

We have something special coming up for those who enjoys watching Eximius tournaments. On the 13th and 14th June, we'll be having an invitational only tournament in the South East Asia region. The tournament will be part of [url=https://www.levelupkl.com/]Level UP Play-One[/url] online event. Do check out the website and the other interesting online activities and seminars. All the competing teams have been invited. We will be sharing more information regarding the teams, times and online streams in the very near future.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/9898c5b27feb9620cbe5b50e0233aaf0fdfd9aaa.jpg[/img]

[h3]Eximius is part of Bitsummit Gaiden![/h3]

For lovers of Indie Games,  we're proud to announce that we'll be part of this year [url=https://bitsummit.org/en/]Bitsummit Gaiden[/url], the first ever online Bitsummit event. The on-site event was supposed to happen a few months back in Kyoto, Japan. However, due to the ongoing pandemic, the event was converted to an online one instead. The event will start on the 27th June. In the mean time, do check out the other cool and amazing indie games being showcased on the website. We'll be sharing more Bitsummit related news sometime in June.

notes.title: Eximius Update - May 22nd, 2020
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/baa52dbc3b26a5fdeaf0fc79fe6229d8b442434c.jpg[/img]

Hello Officers,

In this update, we focused more on improving the FPS component of Eximius. We done some major changes to the AI. Previously, AI units in Eximius will prioritise headshots on their targets. In this update, all AI units will focus on targeting the torso area and will no longer deal headshot damage. We think that this change will give a more consistent FPS experience for everyone. This is a huge change, so please do let us know your thoughts about it.

We also overhauled the recoil system for all weapon. They now use a smooth recoil system. There's a bit of learning needed to get adjusted to these new weapons but your overall FPS experience in Eximius should be improved as well. We also added proper magnification to the Spec-Ops packages of SIGAR and XM13. So snipers, rejoice!

Let us know what you think about the update and changes. As usual you can reach out to us on the Steam Forum or our [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/ammoboxstudios]Discord Channel[/url]. For June, we'll be slightly busy with some online events. Do keep your eyes and ears open for that. We'll share more details with everyone over the next few weeks.

Release Notes for 22nd May 2020

[h1]0.56.3 Changelog[/h1]

[b][New Feature: AI Aim Control System][/b]
- AI Officers and Units now uses an accuracy system when tracking projectile. They will now sometimes miss their shots depending on the speed of the target
- AI units will now correctly smooth turn intead of instantly snapping towards their target. Some units like Ironguard have much slower turn speed
- AI units now no longer deal headshot damage. They will always damage based on centre body hits
- AI units no longer aim at target's head but at the body instead
- AI units now track their targets when firing projectile-based weapon

[b][Revamped Recoil System and Scope Changes][/b]
- Complete revamp on the weapon recoil system. Weapons now use smooth recoil
- All weapons recoil values are adjusted
- Scopes for SIGAR and XM13 Spec-Ops now have proper magnification

[b][Foliage Interaction][/b]
- Tall Foliage now slowly becomes transparent when you go near

[b][Custom Lobby Additions][/b]
- Added Public to Privacy Option
- Added checks to prevent the start of a new match if all members from the previous game are not in the lobby
- Added checks to prevent Match from starting when there are unassigned players
- Added Kick feature
- Players are now auto assigned to Spectator when joining a Custom Lobby
- Spectator and unassigned sections are now merged for better UX

[b][Gameplay Changes][/b]
- AXR Emergency Shield Pack now gives a 30% Movement Speed boost
- Improved visual and sound effect for Flashbang effect
- Adjusted Flashbang effect on allies to 3 second
- Flashbang grenades are now directional dependant. Looking away from the Flashbang will prevent the Flash effect
- Increased the throw speed of all Grenades by 30%
- Reduced GSF Exploit Vanguard Hack border size by 30%
- AXR Mule walking speed slightly increased, sprinting speed slightly decreased
- AXR Shockwave range and projectile speed are slightly increased
- AXR Rook Autocannon undeploys when Rook is flinched

[b][Animation][/b]
- Replaced animation set for GSF Assault Vanguard with a new bulky version

[b][Challenges Changes][/b]
- Challenge Mission Training achievement timeframe increased from 180sec to 240secs 
- Challenge Battlesuit AXR 1. Ironguard now respawns faster and additional covers are added on the map

[b][Fixes][/b]
- Fixed Player not automatically entering Spectator Mode on Death
- Fixed Spectator Cam not being able to cycle to other friendly officers after the first registered player dies
- Fixed Voice Chat Keybinding Does Resets After Game Restart
- Fixed Missing Exit to Menu button during the Final Stage of Setup Lobby
- Fixed Buff Icon appearing on Units when the attribute is not applied
- Fixed Quick throwing Grenades skiping the pulling pin animation
- Fixed Custom Game chat not auto scrolling to the latest message
- Fixed Input not auto focusing to chat box after sending a chat message in Custom Game
- Fixed Matchmaking cancelled by host message not sent to Lobby Spectators
- Fixed players being stuck after player gets the Electrocuted Debuff while playing the equipping Battlesuit animation
- Fixed AXR ISW not dealing suppression damage to enemies
- Fixed AXR Rook Ironguard secondary weapon not deploying correctly sometimes
- Fixed GSF Assault Vanguard firing extra Homing Rockets at targeted enemies
- Fixed GSF Assault Vanguard not updating targeting UI during the second use
- Improved GSF Assault Vanguard Airburst Rocket calculation algorithm. Rockets should hit its target more accurately now
- Fixed GSF Exploit Vanguard being able to Hack a moving target when Line of Sight is broken
- Fixed rare bug where sometimes AXR Aegis Exo-Shield does not breaking when Shield is depleted
- Fixed EMP not disabling Active Protection System (APS) 
- Fixed GSF Skirmish AI not building Armored Logistics at Team 0 location in Downtown
- Fixed physics asset of several units. Units death are less likely to be wonky now
- Fixed AI Squad Members sometimes sitting out of combat due to being out of range
- Fixed Safety Restore check for vehicles
- Fixed Damage Impulse being overapplied due to direct impact explosive having a x5 impulse
- Fixed Vehicle AI not fixing their aim at their target when reloading their weapon
- Fixed Shield information showing for units with no shield in Death Summary

notes.title: Eximius Spring Update - March 28th 2020
notes.notes:
Hello Officers,

We're dropping Eximius 2nd biggest update with our Spring Update. As we inch closer to our 1.0 launch later this year, we're slowly adding features requested by the community and features we think will improve the overall Eximius gameplay experience.

The major highlights in this update is the newly added Contextual Ping. Taking inspiration from other titles like Apex Legends and Rainbow Six: Siege, we hope that having a more robust communication tool will help players coordinate better in Eximius.

We also added Private Lobby for those who prefer to play with their friends (or foes) uninterrupted. Feel free to stream the matches with the available Spectator slots and tools in-game. We plan to add more features such as custom Victory Points.

New and updated weapons are added as well. The ZC9 Handcannon delivers a heavy punch for the AXR faction. We also updated the old trusty GSF S1911 sidekick. New behaviour, model, animation and sound. A new PVP map is added as well. "The Crossing" is more open compare to the other existing maps. We look forward to our PVP battles with the community on this map.

That's all for now. As usual, you can reach us through our Discord channel or the Steam Forums. Send us your suggestion and let us know what you think about the game. Future updates will be even more exciting so do look forward to that.

Signing Out.

Changelogs can be found below.

notes.title: Eximius Update - March 7th, 2020
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/9c8b095e7f1ea0ce29b3a15f80af515c45b6397a.jpg[/img]

Hello Officers,

Here's the first update in March. In this update, we expanded a bit more with the Skirmish AI, slightly reworked the GSF Assault Vanguard abilities and updated the Setup Lobby.

In this update, we made one big gameplay change that we thought was necessary. Making the starting GSF Armoury and AXR Mule indestructible. From our playtest sessions and games with the community, we noticed that it is very challenging for a team to stage a defense once their base armoury is destroyed. We plan to address this issue with this change.

Additionally, the starting AXR Mule is now converted to a static one and mounted on the AXR Command Center.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/d91ae4afd49cc94cd210772cbb6e4ea1a2369990.jpg[/img]
Mounted AXR Mule

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/09a495590079caf6bcf7a36f8670b94c34fd652c.jpg[/img]
New GSF Assault Vanguard Ability UI

In this update, we revisit the very first Battlesuit in the game, the GSF Assault Vanguard. We reworked both abilities slightly to improve the experience of using the abilities. The new targeting UI should be very helpful to players as well.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/f0405d60b38906fc05d5103d9f743cf1db36538c.jpg[/img]
Resource and Victory Points widget are now always visible

Finally, a small treat for the RTS players. We made the Resource and Victory Points to be always visible as well as adding the capture indicator. Expect more RTS improvements over the next few updates.

That's it for now. Our next update will be one of the biggest one yet so check our Discord and Social Media pages for more updates.

Till next time!

notes.title: Eximius Update - February 20th, 2020
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/9c8b095e7f1ea0ce29b3a15f80af515c45b6397a.jpg[/img]

Hello Officers,

This latest update focusing on Skirmish AI may seem like a hotfix on the surface, but there's a lot more going on under the hood.

Functionally, some of the bugs such as units not moving are fixed. Additionally, in the bigger picture, there's a major revamp going on with the Skirmish AI. There are many subtle improvements which improves on how the AI decides where to attack and which points to hold. 

If you're an experienced player, you should find Brutal skirmish significantly more challenging.

As part of the new improvement, Skirmish AI is now able to upgrade tech and use it on units. With this, we'll be seeing upgraded AXR Rook Ironguard and GSF M33's advanced turrets in the field. 

At the moment, we are in the midst of tweaking the AI further to allow them to use artillery and support abilities. You will likely see them added in the game over the next few updates.

Here's a preview on what's coming up over the next few updates:
1)Private Game. A feature which allows you to host a closed match to play with your friends. A highly requested feature by the community. 
2)Battlesuit Ability Revamp. Starting with the GSF Assault Vanguard, we'll have an usability improvement like the previously updated Exploit Vanguard. 

As we march to our 1.0 update this year, we have a few more units that are currently being developed to further boost the variation of strategies you can employ. We will share more details over the next few months.

See you in the next update!

notes.title: Exploit Vanguard Battlesuit To Get UI Improvements In Upcoming Update
notes.notes:
Here's a brief overview of some very nice UI improvements for the Exploit Vanguard Battlesuit that is expected to be included in our next update. Watch the full video further below or catch up on the new improvements in this article.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/ffeb584a821d0380f0a013df5c3ced5f1fbb9359.png[/img]

The Exploit Vanguard is capable of hacking/disrupting all manner of things. Players can disable a vehicle, hack a resource point and even deplete an enemy officer's shields. While it is certainly useful there are a few drawbacks which we have addressed in this coming update.

[previewyoutube=UaTOVOjZrwE;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]1.) White Range Box & Green Reticle[/b]

Previously the Exploit's hacking skill worked with an invisible UI range which made it hard to tell when a hacking connection would break when moving the mouse. Target selection was also based on the highlighted unit instead of the closest target to the player, Now with the White Range Box, players can better see their effective range and the green reticle will highlight hackable targets and will ignore non-hackable targets allowing for more accurate targeting.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/d0083fe0e5c542f961aced6f73639637ebcf9af7.jpg[/img]

[b]2.) Signal Strength Indicator[/b]

The signal strength indicator is found just at the top of the white range box. The icons and bar will change colour from red to green indicating how strong the connection is to allow a hacking sequence. This allows players to know their effective hacking range, so they can tell if they are about to move or look too far away from their target.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/825da026d6423fdd68cb250f98edc46e339ee762.jpg[/img]

[b]3.) Green Incognito Icon Timer[/b]

This new icon appears after a successful hack has been accomplished. It the target that is being hacked can be disabled, the icon will appear and will gradually drain in color, acting as a timer. This will tell the player how much time they have before the target reverts back to normal. This particular icon will be visible to any other player who is also equipped with an Exploit Vanguard Battlesuit for better coordination.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/1cfe2804cb86d2fa0a9ec3f96794e29dd25a5e39.jpg[/img]

This was just one of many more updates to come for our game. Stay tuned for more news as we get closer to the release date. 

See you all on the frontline!

notes.title: Winter Tournament 2020 - Day 2 (Finals) Recap
notes.notes:
The final day of our Winter Tournament 2020 event exemplifies some of the best in strategic execution, pinpoint precision gunplay and exhaustless stamina from our participants!

The first matchup for the day sees the return of SmashGaming, previously knocked out on Day 1 to Team Toasty with a 2-1 loss. As the best performing team from the losing teams in the playoffs, they had a second chance by meeting with Japanese team RHS - Japanese Invaders+. Their spirits were on fire, easily showing their grit as they smashed through with a 2 - 0 win, leaving the Japanese team to pick up the pieces in a clean win.

[previewyoutube=aGDlrO2BvkU;full][/previewyoutube]
[i]The first match begins at 0:45:32[/i]

Moving up the bracket, Alces was ready to show that their might had a right to be in the competition on the road to the finals. After a short intermission for SmashGaming to catch their breath, the match began. In the first game, Alces very quickly gained map control holding 65% of the resources of the map in their race to get their tanks out. Returning champion player TheMightyToast easily carved out a path for the team with his deadly gunplay allowing for a solid first win. In the second match, SmashGaming changed up their gameplan and opted to rush directly for the victory points, going for an early tick down on Alces victory point pool and followed through with some well placed Iron Guard drops, keeping Alces too busy to recapture the victory points, tieing the match 1-1. The final game went to Alces who brought in the M33 tanks with timely upgrades, smashing any chance for SmashGaming to enter the finals.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/0e3b8bc4ed64f450f08df2a560704d59bc979d15.png[/img]

However, there was a chance for redemption for SmashGaming to leave with a piece of the grand prize as they were now matched in the 3rd position fight with their previous rival Team Toasty. Not looking for a repeat, SmashGaming stood firm in their ground, rallying up to a full 3 game match with Team Toasty. Some lessons, however, are learned in the moment, as the first game went to Team Toasty. Taking in what they saw from the quick rush by Team Toasty's officers for the victory points, they played ball and just as quickly sent their own to contest those victory points with a nearly unstoppable supply of GSF Marines and Field Supports. Game 2 went to SmashGaming and with a repeat of their strategy, they nabbed 3rd position and gleefully took the spot with wide smiles.

Moving on to the grand finals, the two teams have shown incredible feats of strategic execution and teamwork, now it was time to see which team was better. At the beginning of game 1, team Malaysia Europe comfortably gained significant ground and held all three victory points, all seemed lost for Alces until a sneaky engineer, micro'd by EmptySoul01 made it's way to the outskirts of Alces's home base and deployed a Barracks. Within moments, a Phalanx Crew was trained and deployed, directed at the left side entrance, bottlenecking any infantry and officers. Supported heavily by the team's heavyweight shooters, TheMightyToast and Fraggoth, it was only a matter of moments when team Malaysia Europe's Command Centre fell.

Which such a dramatic diversion, it was time for team MalaysiaEurope to play their tried and true strategy in game 2, M33 tanks with Reactive Armor. Set in their decision, they began the game with intense concentration. Alces, however, had veteran commander, EmptySoul01 and he still had plenty of tricks up his sleeves. Playing as the AXERON faction, a favorite of his, it was clear as day what play he would use. Opting for Power Plant Overload and enhanced repair pods, Alces would be generating plenty of energy early reducing the need for his teammates to capture energy points to feed the AXERON war machine. It less than 10 minutes, Alces had firmly aligned themselves to victory as 3 of their officers had maneuvered their way into the base and came prepared with battlesuits, MULEs and the very powerful MASER rifle. The win went to Alces 2-0, they will be crowned this year's champions.

With that came a close to our Winter Tournament 2020, we the organizers extend our thanks and gratitude to all the participants and viewers who came online to support our annual event. We look forward to seeing everyone again online and on the frontlines.

Join our [url=https://discord.gg/ammoboxstudios]Discord Channel[/url] to learn about Eximius and follow us on [url=https://www.facebook.com/EximiusGame/?business_id=1917197815240739&ref=bookmarks]Facebook[/url] for updates and events

notes.title: Screenshot Contest - It's time to get EPIC
notes.notes:
Alright officers, it's time to warm up your screenshot buttons as we reveal the next theme for our Screenshot Contest:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/9a5391862b11e9f56f4ac4c18fcc667839924894.jpg[/img]

Let's get EPIC! We want to see some really epic looking screenshots this time like walking away from a huge explosion or seeing a hail of rockets raining down to the ground! Send in as many screenshots as you like, you'll never know one of them might win you a prize.

For those of you who really, [i]REALLY[/i], want to make sure your submissions are included in the list of potential winners, be sure to read the rules* and follow these instructions:

Step 1: Take an screenshot that looks EPIC in game with F12 (Steam Screenshot Tool)

Step 2: Go to your Steam App and click on "View" and click on "Screenshots"

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/ef1af8d7a5b437bb186ac065533ead788e135bb0.png[/img]

Step 3: In the caption box add in "SC_EPIC" with your screenshot title. E.g [b][i]"SC_EPIC Big One.jpg"[/i][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/bc082cc88656a3183348702a702b8deef2bcbf46.png[/img]

Step 4: Click the "Upload" button, select visibility as "Public" and click "Upload" again.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/71da4f46671bd4654a72a389555a66a47a03a553.png[/img]

Once you've done all that, your submission should appear in our Steam Community Hub under the Screenshots tab as Most Recent. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32430909/090183ed2161f31572de764dd4725217707db4ed.png[/img]

And that's all you have to do to submit a screenshot! Easy peasey. You might want to check back from time to time to see what other people have submitted, you may want to submit an even better one to top theirs. ;) 

Good luck!

Rules and Regulations*

[u]Only 1 Winner will be chosen per contest.[/u]

[b]Contest will end on October 1st at 7PM SGT[/b]

The prize will be a Steam Digital Wallet of 5$ or of a similar equivalent depending on your region.

All rules:
[list]
[*] Submit your images to the Steam Community and link your images to our Discord channel.
[*] Please name your files with the SC prefix at the beginning to be considered as an entry.
[*] No other methods of entry will be accepted.
[*] Photo must be an original one taken by the entrant.
[*] No photo edits are allowed.
[*] Your submissions may be disqualified if it breaks any Discord rules.
[*] Entries that do not meet the requirements specified or do not comply with the rules herein may be disqualified. Moderators and Developers will determine what constitutes a valid entry.
[*] Winner is decided by best screenshot submitted, not based on external votes or number of submissions.
[*] Winner is chosen by an internal majority vote.
[*] All decisions are final.
[/list]

notes.title: New In-Game Feature: Weapon Credits
notes.notes:
Greetings officers, 

Here's a quick announcement on the new Weapon Credits System that will be introduced into the game very soon.

Weapon Credits are a separate resource from the existing pool (Money, Energy and Ammo) and will be used by officers to purchase weapons and upgrades from the Armory/MULE. With the introduction of Weapon Credits, both FPS players and RTS players will have more freedom is choosing how to play in their own style without restricting each other.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32430909/671126731ebd3eb650796c0c733b760df03237de.png[/img]
[i]The new Weapon Credits is represented with a gun icon and cash symbol.[/i]

Each officer will have their own pool of weapon credits, so feel free to go on a shopping spree. You won't be denying your friends from getting what they need. 

Weapon Credits will generate over time, similar to the other resources. To generate credits faster, officers will need to capture and hold resource points. The more resource points you control, the more credits you'll get per second. This is ONLY with resource points, Victory Points do not count.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32430909/5416d34a395dab0aeed73e15e6c71cd7c04eb48b.png[/img]

There is a limit however, each officer can [b]only hold up to 2000 Weapon Credits[/b]. In keeping the game balanced, lower tier weapons and upgrades are priced appropriately for quick access, and higher tiered ones will be more expensive. So waiting to buy an expensive gun right away, may not be the best idea as the enemy can overwhelm you really quickly with cheaper guns.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32430909/ff21646c0bf80436a6218ac60720e84ba4c0fda4.png[/img]

Bear in mind that this feature is still in it's final testing phase, so expect some changes to happen as we get closer to it's public release and throughout it's use. We welcome both new players and veterans to give this a try and let us know what you think in our Discord channel:

https://discord.gg/Ammoboxstudios

See you all in the frontline!

notes.title: Our Booth At Digital N8tion 2019
notes.notes:
A huge thank you to everyone who came to try out our game at Digital N8tion 2019 in Kuala Lumpur last weekend!

The amount of positive responses we got was really uplifting for the whole team and all the constructive feedback we gathered will prove to be invaluable in the future of our game's development. We cannot thank you enough for taking the time to meet us and to try out our game.

We were approached by local eSports team, [url=https://www.facebook.com/pg/RimauEsports/posts/]Team Rimau[/url] who play Rainbow 6 professionally for a spot, along with [url=https://www.facebook.com/infinitecarnage2011/]Team Infinite Carnage[/url] (local fighting game community) & the [url=https://www.facebook.com/TaylorsEsports/]Taylor's University Varsity Team[/url] (Meme Council).

A total of three matches were held to decide 1st and 2nd place winners, and each match up was an exciting and illuminating affair. Team Rimau proved their dominance with very strong FPS play taking down numerous units and enemy officers. Team Infinite Carnage took a bit of time to get a handle of the game, but came back fighting in high spirits earning themselves 2nd place. 1st place went to Meme Council with their very fast paced strategy of zone control using GSF's Point Defenses and well prepared officers.

The whole event was a resounding success. Response to our game was very well received and the amount of feedback from the professional teams and audience members showed very positive interest to see our game grow bigger. We aim to continue our development of Eximius: Seize the Frontline with the feedback in mind and also to participate in more events as we make our way to a full release.

To all our players, new and seasoned, we thank you for your support and hope you continue to have fun playing our game. :)

notes.title: Announcement on DMCA Notice
notes.notes:
ANNOUNCEMENT : 
Dear Community. We (Ammobox Studios) are forced to issue a DMCA Notice to our own game Eximius: Seize the Frontline. As a result, the Steam store page has been temporarily disabled.

So what happened? 
Long story short, we had to file a DMCA against our very own game on Steam to wrest it off the Publisher (TheGameWallStudios).
The DMCA has just kicked in resulting in the game being taken off the Steam Store Page.
Legal action is in process of being taken because the publisher has went off grid and has not made any payment of the sale of the game to developers. TheGameWallStudios has breached publishing agreement and their rights to distribute has been terminated.

So what does this mean? 
Owners of the games can still play the game and receive new updates with no problem. The dev team and the servers are still around and running. It's just that new players won’t be able to purchase it for the time being. As of writing, if you bought the game recently through other online digital distribution stores, the key will still activate on Steam with no problem. We will continue to update this situation as it develops. 

IMPORTANT NOTE : They still own the Steam application rights, Store Page and have full access as far as Steam is concerned. This post might be deleted, modified and the Community Hub be entirely blocked. Our updates might completely be locked out as we don’t know what will happen.
We are still very much active in our Discord ( www.discord.gg/ammoboxstudios) and Facebook page( https://www.facebook.com/EximiusGame/) as long as the Steam Community Hub is still alive we’ll be around it as well. Feel free to chat with us there.

notes.title: Eximius 2019 Development Roadmap
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32430909/17d68955b8701354feddbb35c2acdec0003e2c23.jpg[/img]

[b]Greetings Officers,

After weeks of discussion we are finally ready to share our development plans with you. As mentioned before, we plan to have Eximius exiting Early Access phase by Q3 2019. We have a lot of work to do to get there and we would like to invite you to join us throughout our Early Access journey. But first, a recap on Q4 2018. [/b]

[h1]Q4 2018[/h1]
[list]
[*] [strike]Halloween Update[/strike]
[*] [strike]Comms & Matchmaking Update[/strike]
[*] [b]Tournament Update[/b]
[*] [b]Faction Update 01[/b]
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32430909/2bb8db275236d6df651df173dc90e928b9689d25.jpg[/img]

[b]We're pushing out the Tournament Update very soon in conjunction with the first ever [url=https://www.toornament.com/tournaments/1973264354154627072/information]Eximius Tournament[/url]. We updated the Spectator UI and fixed some Spectator related bug. Downtown, Express and Central maps are also updated with minor changes for the tournament.[/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32430909/db22953aba0b8e8638eedcf102fce8e71e2bd0f8.jpg[/img]

[b]After the Tournament Update, we will release the Faction Update 01. In this update the GSF faction will receive 1 new Unit and 1 new Weapon for the Officers. The AXR faction will receive 2 new Units and 1 new Weapon for the Officers. These new additions should shake up on how games are being played currently.[/b]


[h1]Q1 2019[/h1]
[list]
[*][b] Improvement Cycle[/b]
[*] [b]Tutorial Update[/b]
[*] [b]Equipment Update[/b]
[*] [b]Level Update[/b]
[*] [b]Battlesuit Update[/b]
[*] [b]Social & Progression Update[/b]
[*] [b]War Room Update[/b]
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32430909/797a916b0bc5241ad25baf10864226d72c9833bd.jpg[/img]

[b]The first thing that we'll do is to allocate some time to improve the game from multiple angles such as the FPS/RTS experience, animation, weapons, battlesuits, UI and other Quality of Life (QoL) improvements. During this period, we invite you to join our community at Discord to talk to us about what changes you would like to see that would help make the game more polished.
[/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32430909/c7a760a5e919b6370b4b2f61cffe2d53bfe6af26.jpg[/img]

[b]We also plan to update the existing Tutorial. While it's currently working, we think that a good update will help new and existing players with understanding the game better.[/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32430909/b768812fee2e45b87959bc8a0ff0fe642fa05c12.jpg[/img]
[b]
As for the Equipment Update, we are planning to add a grenade equipment. This addition should open up more combat possibilities on both FPS and RTS side. We're thinking of including other equipment such as landmines, portable health/ammo packs but we're still experimenting on our side. Do drop us a comment below if you have any ideas for us.[/b] ːsteamhappyː

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32430909/abba10162c04b14cad8e3563a366757479e70cb7.jpg[/img]

[b]For the Level Update, 2 new maps will be added to the game. 1 PVP level and 1 PVE level. We'll share more info when the time comes but we think that these 2 will be the best levels yet in Eximius. [/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32430909/e70fdbcfdf3c8aae53746379e614aff758ad0d60.jpg[/img]

[b]With the Battlesuit update we will add 1 new battlesuit for GSF and 1 for AXR. These Battlesuits will add more impactful choices and utilities for both the Commander and Officers. We are also thinking of changing on how the Battlesuit is built and delivered to the Officers. We may let the Officers to call down a Battlesuit of their choice instead of having it being built and sent by the Commander. We'll keep testing it out on our end before changing the delivery system.[/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32430909/c964bd0fa60427b59580924e4314f5680ac39fc7.jpg[/img]

[b]One of the most interesting challenges we will be tackling is the Social and Progression system. The current leveling system in the game is at its infancy and we plan to grow it. We're thinking of introducing Unlockables, things like callsign and banners and eventually (maybe) skins and other doodads that players will enjoy. Customisable player profile will be added as well. You need to look your best when heading out to the frontline.[/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32430909/a352827f5804e9bcd77f63f73e52dd5e8e4de153.jpg[/img]

[b]Finally for Q1 2019, the War Room update. The War Room is planned to replace the existing Planning Lobby (Hangar) where players choose their Commander and tech before the start of a match. We plan to add more interactivity and functionality to help players plan better before the start of a game. For example, showing what level is being played in the War Room will open up discussions on which Victory Points to attack or defend. It will be an exciting update for sure.[/b]

[h1]Q2 2019[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]Faction Update 02[/b]
[*] [b]Battlesuit Update 02[/b]
[*] [b]Level Update 02[/b]
[*][b] Squad Improvement Update[/b]
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32430909/83f13046064983455768c3bae0fcb5a2c1b91a99.jpg[/img]

[b]Entering Q2 2019, we'll start with the 2nd Faction Update. More Vehicles and stronger Units will be added into the game. We also plan to include more Vehicle and Weapon upgrades. This update is sure to excite RTS players on the possibilities of creating and combining strategies. [/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32430909/89060568ae67645ec16b8adaa5ec3892b448519e.jpg[/img]

[b]Battlesuit Update 02 will see 2 new Battlesuits being added to the game. 1 for GSF and the other for AXR. By this point, there will be 3 Battlesuit on each faction.We plan to include more Battlesuits after the V1.0 launch as they are an integral part of Eximius.[/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32430909/25270b642a703ca4dba9913a5fae4f28f1bb1d9f.jpg[/img]

[b]2 new levels will be added with the Level Updates 02 update. Again, we'll be adding 1 new PVP and 1 new PVE level. More details will be shared in the future.[/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32430909/3a67a3c2a0cb841f20caaf3c3fdc66820c950b5c.jpg[/img]

[b]Squad Improvement Update will be one of the other interesting challenges we will face. We will be working on updating the AI Squad Experience. Currently, AI units that are attached to Officers have limited capabilities on what they can do. We plan to expand that to allow Officers to execute more complex strategies with the fellow Officers and Commanders.
[/b]

[h1]Q3 2019[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]Localisation[/b]
[*][b] Lore Development[/b]
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32430909/65da912a91d83e29580001d543c3ee92134e91d9.jpg[/img]

[b]With the core content for V1.0 being completed or close to completion, we can finally begin on localisation work. For fans who are waiting for localisation support, we can only ask for you patience and understanding at the moment. Rest assured, we will work on it when we get there.[/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32430909/b1e94da97997d898d94f01cbb6f8fda2d4a2691b.jpg[/img]

[b]Lore Development is something we are doing throughout Eximius development. Ever wondered why AXR (no, they're not aliens) seems more advanced than GSF or why do the cities look abandoned? We hope to answer these questions and share more background regarding the world of Eximius here.[/b]

[b]The team will also be constantly working on bug fixes and updating the game throughout Q3 2019.[/b]
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[b]And there you have it, the development plan for Eximius. One thing to note though, things may change throughout the development for Eximius but we plan to stick to it the best we can. We'll be sure to update you should there be any potential changes, with good reasons.

We look forward to your suggestions and feedback throughout the development. Thank You for reading.[/b] ːsteamhappyː

[b]Dismissed[/b]

With this update, PVP mode is now unlocked. For the time being, only the GSF faction is unlocked. Major matchmaking issues players faced last week should have been resolved as well.

So expect some weird and funny AI decision making. We look forward to your feedback to help us improve the AI.

Till next time
