notes.title: DEV BLOG #02 - Gearing Up
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32430909/9c336fc3a1a24f13a7ed2d6336883c07a695cff4.jpg[/img]

Attention Officers,

“Full speed ahead” is the only acceptable term describing what’s going on in Ammobox Studios. We’ve been very busy lately with setting up the Axeron Faction and putting up the final touches for the BETA. 


[h1][b]BETA Info[/b][/h1]

We been getting a lot of requests on when is the BETA and how can one get their hands on it. We would like to thank everyone for their interest as well as patience. Internally, we knew that preparation for the BETA will be challenging and time consuming and boy, it really has been. A lot of time is spent on preparing the servers to ensure you get the best online experience possible.

As for when and how to access the BETA, we will announce it within 2 weeks time. Keep your eyes peeled on our social media pages, you don’t want to miss it. In the meantime, please make do with the teaser image above.


[h1][b]Axeron Faction[/b][/h1]

We are preparing the Axeron faction to be playable for the upcoming BETA as well. This will be an all-new faction with new units, weapons, vehicles and abilities. Commanders that favours guerilla and hit and run tactics will surely find Axeron being their primary choice.

With Omni Balls, Axeron buildings have the unique ability to move and deploy almost everywhere on the battlefield. This mobility will give Axeron Commanders the element of surprise when used properly.

[b][u]Axeron Building Movement [/u][/b]
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NDXKyUPUVfA

[b][u]Axeron Mule [/u][/b]
Axeron Commander can also deploy the Mule, a mobile armoury providing weapons and supplies to Axeron Officers at the frontline. Players will need to pay extra attention to protect the Mule from enemy fire. While it is agile and nimble, it is not built to take punishment.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZA7PjAHWXRQ
[i]It's quite adorable when you look at it[/i]

[b][u]Axeron Weapons [/u][/b]
Here's also a preview at the arsenal available to Axeron Officers/Players. More heavy firepower to be added after Early Access.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32430909/3c5a9a213e42c399f96ca9ecda85bc80c1bb51e8.jpg[/img]

We will share more Axeron gameplay content over the next few weeks. For the time being, you can check our social media channels for new Axeron updates.


[h1][b]Homeland Security (Co-Op Map)[/b][/h1]

We also have been developing a new Co-Op Map titled ‘Homeland Security’. The main objective is to survive against waves of enemies looking to destroy your base. You can squad up with 4 other friends while taking on this mission.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32430909/704cf218615a519b87425f2bdce2ab7c2459d1a8.png[/img]


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32430909/2c37294bac349d73d3196a22ef2c273ccb0fbec0.png[/img]


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32430909/6d6593d12806b245a7731719d4ea2cd1f1ce63a7.png[/img]


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32430909/fa4187f3103603eedd5b00ffd05ca3fc664128f7.png[/img]


We also plan to add dynamic objectives to make every playthrough a unique and exciting one. We might be streaming this level on our weekly developer livestream sometime this week. Come join us and let us know what do you think about this level. We can’t wait to hear your feedback and response from this Co-Op experience.


[h1][b]Quality of Life Improvements[/b][/h1]
Other than the major updates above, we also have been making some minor improvements in terms of gameplay and quality of life. You can check out the updated armoury in the video below. We will be actively gathering usability data from users when the BETA period begins. With this data, we hope to improve the game better.

https://youtu.be/Uet31goNSnA


That’s all for now. Look forward to the BETA announcement very soon. Till next time.

Dismissed.

notes.title: DEV BLOG #1
notes.notes:
Attention Officers,

Summer is approaching and it’s getting livelier by the minute at Ammobox Studios. The team is working hard on preparing the upcoming BETA build of the game that is scheduled to go LIVE sometime in between July and August. 

In the meantime, you may have notice that we are getting chattier on our social media. We realised that we haven’t been communicating with you - our community as frequently as we should have. We are taking steps to improve that. We are grateful and thankful for your continuous support over the years.

This Dev Blog will serve as a communication channel to our community. We intend to share more behind the scenes information, the talented team working on the game and other shenanigans. We hope you enjoy the read and welcome you to join us on this exciting adventure.

So what’s been going on over the past few weeks? We had some European and South American publishers testing out the game. They gave some valuable feedback in the process which will help us in improving the game. Eximius was also featured in Alienware roadshows in Singapore. A custom single-player survival mode was created just for Alienware. You can check it out here.  
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Mdyr2Yd6Gl8

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32430909/f004851e6ac75ee64051781f24721365df266259.jpg[/img]
[i] Glorious 4K Resolution [/i]


On a side note, Eximius will be playable in Singapore this coming weekend at Asia Game Festival. (https://asiagamefest.com/)  Our friends from Matchroom will be showcasing the game. (https://www.matchroom.net/) It’ll be the improved version of the survival-oriented ‘Alienware Build’. If you are attending Asia Game Festival this weekend, do check out the game at booth AGF-C09. There are prizes to be won and complimentary BETA keys to be given away. Give us a shout-out if you happen to be there.

We also had the opportunity to meet up with Chris Murphy, an Evangelist for Epic Games. He was in the region giving some talks on Getting Started with Unreal Engine and Technical Art and VFX with UE4. For the young and budding game developers out there who wants to learn more, you can check out his course at Udemy. (https://www.udemy.com/unreale4/)  

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32430909/6c29b6822d796fd379f59e82b6b09d58c8c089b6.jpg[/img]
[i] Serious Conversation All Around [/i]


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32430909/9656227e059ea723461371d2c532f6b82c42f2fe.jpg[/img]
[i] Big Swag, Happy Man [/i]


On the development side, you may have notice that we have started showing some upcoming Axeron Contents and a new level titled 'Express City'. We'll be playtesting Express City regularly over the next few weeks. There are some balance and fun issues with it now but we are confident we can iron out those kinks soon.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32430909/d0b346d9af1fc1e7cbffadf7fa13fd131535ca25.png[/img]
[i] First Pass. Better Look, Coming Soon[/i]


That’s all for now. We plan to include more art and tech related content in our next dev blog post. As usual, you can keep in touch with us through our social media channels or comment away below. We’ll be here to answer. Till next time.

Dismissed.
